AI.title_translation: 潜空间中基于学习距离梯度的局部路径优化
AI.tldr: 针对机器人受限运动规划中潜空间方法的效率问题，本文提出了一种利用神经网络学习距离梯度进行潜空间局部路径优化的方法，显著提高了规划速度。
AI.motivation: 受限运动规划在机器人操作中具有挑战性。现有的基于流形近似的潜运动方法，由于流形近似误差和在潜空间中难以准确识别碰撞，导致需要耗时的路径有效性检查和路径重新规划。
AI.method: 训练一个神经网络，以潜向量作为输入，预测机器人与障碍物之间的最小距离。然后利用学习到的距离梯度来计算潜空间中的移动方向，使机器人远离障碍物。在此基础上，提出了一个潜空间中的局部路径优化算法，并将其与路径有效性检查过程相结合，以减少重新规划的时间。
AI.result: 在多个规划场景中与最先进的算法进行比较，证明了其规划速度最快。
AI.translation: 受限运动规划是机器人操作中一个常见但具有挑战性的问题。近年来，数据驱动的受限运动规划算法展现出令人印象深刻的规划速度和成功率。其中，基于流形近似的潜运动方法是最有效的规划算法。然而，由于流形近似中的误差以及在潜空间中准确识别碰撞冲突的难度，需要进行耗时的路径有效性检查和路径重新规划。在本文中，我们提出了一种方法，该方法训练一个神经网络，利用潜向量作为输入来预测机器人与障碍物之间的最小距离。然后利用学习到的距离梯度来计算潜空间中的移动方向，使机器人远离障碍物。在此基础上，提出了一种潜空间中的局部路径优化算法，并将其与路径有效性检查过程相结合，以减少重新规划的时间。所提出的方法在多个规划场景中与最先进的算法进行了比较，证明了其规划速度最快。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于潜空间的受限运动规划中效率低、需频繁重新规划的问题，提出了一种创新的局部路径优化方法。该方法通过训练神经网络学习距离梯度，利用梯度信息在潜空间中引导机器人远离障碍物，从而在路径有效性检查过程中集成局部优化步骤，有效减少了重新规划的次数和时间。实验结果表明，该方法在规划速度上超越了现有最先进的算法。
AI.keywords: 受限运动规划, 潜空间, 距离梯度, 局部路径优化, 神经网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将碰撞规避的几何信息（最小距离梯度）学习并嵌入到潜空间（Latent Space）中，从而在规划的低维表示中直接进行局部优化。这解决了传统潜运动方法中，碰撞检测和路径调整必须依赖于高维原始空间，导致效率低下的核心问题。通过将优化与有效性检查相结合，极大地提高了规划效率，对于实时机器人操作具有重要意义。潜在的局限性可能在于神经网络学习的距离预测的准确性对整个系统的鲁棒性影响较大。

title: LiftProj: Space Lifting and Projection-Based Panorama Stitching
summary: Traditional image stitching techniques have predominantly utilized two-dimensional homography transformations and mesh warping to achieve alignment on a planar surface. While effective for scenes that are approximately coplanar or exhibit minimal parallax, these approaches often result in ghosting, structural bending, and stretching distortions in non-overlapping regions when applied to real three-dimensional scenes characterized by multiple depth layers and occlusions. Such challenges are exacerbated in multi-view accumulations and 360° closed-loop stitching scenarios. In response, this study introduces a spatially lifted panoramic stitching framework that initially elevates each input image into a dense three-dimensional point representation within a unified coordinate system, facilitating global cross-view fusion augmented by confidence metrics. Subsequently, a unified projection center is established in three-dimensional space, and an equidistant cylindrical projection is employed to map the fused data onto a single panoramic manifold, thereby producing a geometrically consistent 360° panoramic layout. Finally, hole filling is conducted within the canvas domain to address unknown regions revealed by viewpoint transitions, restoring continuous texture and semantic coherence. This framework reconceptualizes stitching from a two-dimensional warping paradigm to a three-dimensional consistency paradigm and is designed to flexibly incorporate various three-dimensional lifting and completion modules. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed method substantially mitigates geometric distortions and ghosting artifacts in scenarios involving significant parallax and complex occlusions, yielding panoramic results that are more natural and consistent.

AI.title_translation: LiftProj：基于空间提升和投影的全景图拼接
AI.tldr: 传统二维拼接不适用于复杂三维场景。我们提出了LiftProj，通过将图像提升到三维空间并进行融合，然后投影生成全景图，从而解决了视差引起的失真和重影问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的二维拼接技术（如单应性变换和网格扭曲）在具有多深度层、遮挡和显著视差的真实三维场景中会导致重影、结构弯曲和拉伸失真，尤其在多视图累积和360度闭环拼接中问题更严重。
AI.method: 引入了一个空间提升的全景拼接框架。首先，将每张输入图像提升到统一坐标系中的密集三维点表示，并通过置信度指标进行全局跨视图融合。其次，在三维空间中建立统一的投影中心，并采用等距圆柱投影将融合数据映射到单个全景流形上。最后，在画布域内进行空洞填充，以恢复纹理和语义连贯性。
AI.result: 实验证明，该方法能显著减轻涉及显著视差和复杂遮挡场景中的几何失真和重影伪影，生成更自然和一致的全景结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将拼接从二维扭曲范式重新概念化为三维一致性范式，并证明了其在复杂场景中减轻失真和重影的有效性。
AI.translation: 传统的图像拼接技术主要利用二维单应性变换和网格扭曲来在平面上实现对齐。虽然对于近似共面或视差极小的场景有效，但当应用于具有多深度层和遮挡的真实三维场景时，这些方法通常会在非重叠区域导致重影、结构弯曲和拉伸失真。在多视图累积和360度闭环拼接场景中，此类挑战尤为突出。为应对此问题，本研究引入了一个空间提升的全景拼接框架，该框架首先将每张输入图像提升到统一坐标系中的密集三维点表示，并通过置信度指标增强，促进全局跨视图融合。随后，在三维空间中建立统一的投影中心，并采用等距圆柱投影将融合后的数据映射到单个全景流形上，从而生成几何一致的360度全景布局。最后，在画布域内进行空洞填充，以解决由视点转换揭示的未知区域，恢复连续的纹理和语义连贯性。该框架将拼接从二维扭曲范式重新概念化为三维一致性范式，并且设计上可灵活地整合各种三维提升和补全模块。实验评估表明，所提出的方法能显著减轻涉及显著视差和复杂遮挡场景中的几何失真和重影伪影，生成更自然和一致的全景结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LiftProj，一个基于空间提升和投影的全景拼接框架。该框架将输入图像提升为三维点表示，进行全局融合，然后通过统一的投影中心将其映射到圆柱全景流形上。这种方法将拼接范式从二维扭曲转变为三维一致性，有效减轻了复杂三维场景中由视差和遮挡引起的几何失真和重影伪影。
AI.keywords: 空间提升, 全景拼接, 3D一致性, 视差缓解
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将全景拼接的范式从依赖二维扭曲转变为追求三维空间中的一致性。通过在三维空间中处理视差和遮挡，该方法从根本上解决了传统单应性方法在复杂场景中出现的重影和结构失真问题。其灵活的设计允许集成不同的三维提升和补全模块，具有很强的扩展性。

title: One-shot synthesis of rare gastrointestinal lesions improves diagnostic accuracy and clinical training
summary: Rare gastrointestinal lesions are infrequently encountered in routine endoscopy, restricting the data available for developing reliable artificial intelligence (AI) models and training novice clinicians. Here we present EndoRare, a one-shot, retraining-free generative framework that synthesizes diverse, high-fidelity lesion exemplars from a single reference image. By leveraging language-guided concept disentanglement, EndoRare separates pathognomonic lesion features from non-diagnostic attributes, encoding the former into a learnable prototype embedding while varying the latter to ensure diversity. We validated the framework across four rare pathologies (calcifying fibrous tumor, juvenile polyposis syndrome, familial adenomatous polyposis, and Peutz-Jeghers syndrome). Synthetic images were judged clinically plausible by experts and, when used for data augmentation, significantly enhanced downstream AI classifiers, improving the true positive rate at low false-positive rates. Crucially, a blinded reader study demonstrated that novice endoscopists exposed to EndoRare-generated cases achieved a 0.400 increase in recall and a 0.267 increase in precision. These results establish a practical, data-efficient pathway to bridge the rare-disease gap in both computer-aided diagnostics and clinical education.

AI.title_translation: 稀有胃肠道病变的一次性合成提高了诊断准确性和临床培训
AI.tldr: EndoRare是一种“一次性”生成框架，能从单个图像合成多样化、高保真的稀有胃肠道病变图像，显著提高了AI诊断准确性并增强了新手内窥镜医师的临床召回率和精确度。
AI.motivation: 稀有胃肠道病变在常规内窥镜检查中不常遇到，限制了可用于开发可靠AI模型和培训新手临床医生的数据。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为EndoRare的“一次性”、免再训练的生成框架。它利用语言引导的概念解耦，将病灶的病理特征与非诊断属性分离，前者编码为可学习的原型嵌入，后者用于变化以确保多样性。
AI.result: 框架在四种稀有病理学上得到验证。合成图像被专家判断为临床可信。用于数据增强时，显著增强了下游AI分类器，提高了低假阳性率下的真阳性率。新手内窥镜医师通过接触EndoRare生成的病例，召回率提高了0.400，精确度提高了0.267。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一种实用且数据高效的途径，用于弥合计算机辅助诊断和临床教育中的罕见疾病数据鸿沟。
AI.translation: 稀有胃肠道病变在常规内窥镜检查中不常遇到，限制了可用于开发可靠人工智能（AI）模型和培训新手临床医生的数据。本文提出了EndoRare，这是一个“一次性”、免再训练的生成框架，它能从单个参考图像合成多样化、高保真的病变样本。EndoRare利用语言引导的概念解耦，将病理性的病变特征与非诊断属性分离，将前者编码为可学习的原型嵌入，同时变化后者以确保多样性。我们在四种稀有病理学（钙化性纤维瘤、青少年息肉病综合征、家族性腺瘤性息肉病和Peutz-Jeghers综合征）中验证了该框架。合成图像被专家判断为临床可信，当用于数据增强时，显著增强了下游AI分类器，提高了低假阳性率下的真阳性率。至关重要的是，一项盲法阅读器研究表明，接触过EndoRare生成病例的新手内窥镜医师，其召回率提高了0.400，精确度提高了0.267。这些结果为弥合计算机辅助诊断和临床教育中的罕见疾病数据鸿沟建立了一条实用且数据高效的途径。
AI.summary: EndoRare是一种“一次性”生成框架，专为解决稀有胃肠道病变数据不足的问题而设计。它利用语言引导的概念解耦，从单个图像中合成高保真且多样化的病变样本。实验证明，合成图像不仅获得了专家认可，还能显著增强下游AI分类器的性能，并且使新手内窥镜医师的召回率和精确度大幅提高，为罕见疾病的计算机辅助诊断和临床教育提供了一条数据高效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 稀有病变, 一次性合成, 生成框架, AI诊断, 临床培训
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于其“一次性、免再训练”的生成框架（EndoRare），有效地解决了稀有医疗数据极度匮乏的核心挑战。技术上，利用“语言引导的概念解耦”来分离病变特征和背景属性，保证了合成数据的保真度和多样性。其重要性在于它同时解决了计算机辅助诊断和临床教育中的数据鸿沟，为罕见疾病的AI模型开发和新手培训提供了一条实用且数据高效的路径。

title: Safe Sliding Mode Control for Marine Vessels Using High-Order Control Barrier Functions and Fast Projection
summary: This paper presents a novel safe control framework that integrates Sliding Mode Control (SMC), High-Order Control Barrier Functions (HOCBFs) with state-dependent adaptiveness and a lightweight projection for collision-free navigation of an over-actuated 3-DOF marine surface vessel subjected to strong environmental disturbances (wind, waves, and current). SMC provides robustness to matched disturbances common in marine operations, while HOCBFs enforce forward invariance of obstacle-avoidance constraints. A fast half-space projection method adjusts the SMC control only when needed, preserving robustness and minimizing chattering. The approach is evaluated on a nonlinear marine platform model that includes added mass, hydrodynamic damping, and full thruster allocation. Simulation results show robust navigation, guaranteed obstacle avoidance, and computational efficiency suitable for real-time embedded use. For small marine robots and surface vessels with limited onboard computational resources-where execution speed and computational efficiency are critical-the SMC-HOCBF framework constitutes a strong candidate for safety-critical control.

AI.title_translation: 基于高阶控制障碍函数和快速投影的船舶安全滑模控制
AI.tldr: 一种结合鲁棒滑模控制（SMC）和高阶控制障碍函数（HOCBF）及快速投影的新型框架，实现了在强干扰下船舶高效、有保证的无碰撞导航。
AI.motivation: 实现过驱动三自由度水面船舶在强环境干扰（风、浪、流）下的无碰撞导航，并确保鲁棒性和计算效率。
AI.method: 整合了滑模控制（SMC）以提供对匹配干扰的鲁棒性；带有状态依赖自适应性的高阶控制障碍函数（HOCBFs）以强制执行避障约束的前向不变性；以及一种快速半空间投影方法，仅在需要时调整SMC控制，从而最大限度地减少抖振并保持鲁棒性。该方法在一个包含附加质量、水动力阻尼和完整推进器分配的非线性海洋平台模型上进行了评估。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示出鲁棒的导航性能、有保证的避障能力，以及适用于实时嵌入式使用的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: SMC-HOCBF框架是资源有限的小型海洋机器人和水面船舶安全关键控制的有力候选方案，尤其适用于对执行速度和计算效率要求高的场景。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新颖的安全控制框架，该框架集成了滑模控制（SMC）、具有状态依赖自适应性的高阶控制障碍函数（HOCBFs）和轻量级投影，用于在遭受强环境干扰（风、浪、流）的过驱动三自由度水面船舶上实现无碰撞导航。SMC为海洋作业中常见的匹配干扰提供了鲁棒性，而HOCBFs则强制执行避障约束的前向不变性。一种快速半空间投影方法仅在需要时调整SMC控制，从而保持鲁棒性并最大限度地减少抖振。该方法在一个包含附加质量、水动力阻尼和完整推进器分配的非线性海洋平台模型上进行了评估。仿真结果显示出鲁棒导航、有保证的避障能力以及适用于实时嵌入式使用的计算效率。对于船载计算资源有限——执行速度和计算效率至关重要——的小型海洋机器人和水面船舶，SMC-HOCBF框架构成了安全关键控制的有力候选方案。
AI.summary: 一种新颖的安全控制框架整合了鲁棒滑模控制（SMC）和高阶控制障碍函数（HOCBFs）以及快速投影方法，旨在实现船舶在强环境干扰下的无碰撞导航。SMC提供鲁棒性，HOCBFs保证避障安全性，而快速投影则在保持鲁棒性的同时最小化抖振。仿真结果验证了其鲁棒导航、安全性保障和高计算效率，使其适用于资源受限的海洋平台。
AI.keywords: 滑模控制, 控制障碍函数, 船舶, 避碰, 快速投影
AI.comments: 创新点在于有效整合了鲁棒控制（SMC）和安全关键控制（HOCBF），并使用了计算高效的“快速半空间投影”。这解决了海洋机器人领域常见的挑战：即在计算资源有限的情况下，既需要抵抗干扰的高鲁棒性，又需要实时保证安全性。该方法在包含完整推力分配的过驱动三自由度模型上的应用表明其控制设计具有高度的保真度。

title: DRL-TH: Jointly Utilizing Temporal Graph Attention and Hierarchical Fusion for UGV Navigation in Crowded Environments
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods have demonstrated potential for autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance of unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) in crowded environments. Most existing approaches rely on single-frame observation and employ simple concatenation for multi-modal fusion, which limits their ability to capture temporal context and hinders dynamic adaptability. To address these challenges, we propose a DRL-based navigation framework, DRL-TH, which leverages temporal graph attention and hierarchical graph pooling to integrate historical observations and adaptively fuse multi-modal information. Specifically, we introduce a temporal-guided graph attention network (TG-GAT) that incorporates temporal weights into attention scores to capture correlations between consecutive frames, thereby enabling the implicit estimation of scene evolution. In addition, we design a graph hierarchical abstraction module (GHAM) that applies hierarchical pooling and learnable weighted fusion to dynamically integrate RGB and LiDAR features, achieving balanced representation across multiple scales. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DRL-TH outperforms existing methods in various crowded environments. We also implemented DRL-TH control policy on a real UGV and showed that it performed well in real world scenarios.

AI.title_translation: DRL-TH：联合利用时序图注意力机制和分层融合实现拥挤环境下的UGV导航
AI.tldr: 针对拥挤环境中UGV导航中缺乏时序上下文和多模态融合简单的问题，本文提出了DRL-TH框架，它使用时序图注意力网络（TG-GAT）处理历史信息和估计场景演变，并使用图分层抽象模块（GHAM）动态融合RGB和LiDAR特征，实验证明效果优于现有方法，并在真实UGV上得到了验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的用于拥挤环境中UGV导航的深度强化学习（DRL）方法大多依赖单帧观测，并采用简单的拼接进行多模态融合，这限制了它们捕获时序上下文的能力，并阻碍了动态适应性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于DRL的导航框架DRL-TH，该框架利用时序图注意力机制和分层图池化来整合历史观测并自适应地融合多模态信息。具体包括：1. **时序引导图注意力网络 (TG-GAT)**：将时序权重纳入注意力分数中，以捕获连续帧之间的相关性，从而隐式估计场景演变。2. **图分层抽象模块 (GHAM)**：应用分层池化和可学习的加权融合，动态整合RGB和LiDAR特征，实现跨多尺度的平衡表示。
AI.result: DRL-TH在各种拥挤环境中均优于现有方法。此外，DRL-TH控制策略在真实UGV上得到实施，并在真实世界场景中表现良好。
AI.translation: 深度强化学习（DRL）方法在无人地面车辆（UGV）于拥挤环境中的自主导航和避障方面已展现出潜力。现有的大多数方法依赖单帧观测并采用简单的拼接进行多模态融合，这限制了它们捕获时序上下文的能力，并阻碍了动态适应性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于DRL的导航框架——DRL-TH，该框架利用时序图注意力机制和分层图池化来整合历史观测并自适应地融合多模态信息。具体而言，我们引入了一个时序引导图注意力网络（TG-GAT），它将时序权重纳入注意力分数中，以捕获连续帧之间的相关性，从而实现场景演变的隐式估计。此外，我们设计了一个图分层抽象模块（GHAM），它应用分层池化和可学习的加权融合来动态整合RGB和LiDAR特征，实现了跨多个尺度的平衡表示。广泛的实验证明，我们的DRL-TH在各种拥挤环境中均优于现有方法。我们还在真实的UGV上实施了DRL-TH控制策略，并表明它在真实世界场景中表现良好。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DRL-TH框架，旨在解决拥挤环境中UGV导航中缺乏时序上下文和多模态融合简单的问题。DRL-TH通过时序引导图注意力网络（TG-GAT）整合历史观测并估计场景演变，并通过图分层抽象模块（GHAM）动态融合RGB和LiDAR等多模态特征，实现了多尺度平衡表示。实验证明DRL-TH在模拟和真实世界的拥挤环境中均优于现有导航方法。
AI.keywords: 深度强化学习, UGV导航, 时序图注意力, 分层融合, 多模态
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将时序信息和多模态融合问题结合，通过图神经网络结构进行统一处理。TG-GAT通过引入时序权重解决了传统图注意力网络在处理连续帧时缺乏时间依赖性的问题，而GHAM则解决了多模态特征简单拼接导致表示不平衡的问题。该方法对于提升DRL在动态、高复杂度环境（如拥挤场景）中导航的鲁棒性和适应性具有重要意义。

title: Data Heterogeneity-Aware Client Selection for Federated Learning in Wireless Networks
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables mobile edge devices, functioning as clients, to collaboratively train a decentralized model while ensuring local data privacy. However, the efficiency of FL in wireless networks is limited not only by constraints on communication and computational resources but also by significant data heterogeneity among clients, particularly in large-scale networks. This paper first presents a theoretical analysis of the impact of client data heterogeneity on global model generalization error, which can result in repeated training cycles, increased energy consumption, and prolonged latency. Based on the theoretical insights, an optimization problem is formulated to jointly minimize learning latency and energy consumption while constraining generalization error. A joint client selection and resource allocation (CSRA) approach is then proposed, employing a series of convex optimization and relaxation techniques. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed CSRA scheme yields higher test accuracy, reduced learning latency, and lower energy consumption compared to baseline methods that do not account for data heterogeneity.

AI.title_translation: 无线网络中联邦学习的数据异构感知客户端选择
AI.tldr: 针对无线联邦学习中数据异构导致的效率低下问题，本文进行了理论分析，并提出了联合客户端选择和资源分配（CSRA）方案，通过优化客户端选择和资源分配，有效最小化了延迟和能耗，同时保证了模型准确性。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习（FL）在无线网络中的效率受限于通信和计算资源，以及大规模网络中客户端之间显著的数据异构性。数据异构性会导致全局模型泛化误差，进而引起重复训练周期、增加能耗和延长延迟，因此需要一种能感知数据异构性的优化方案。
AI.method: 首先，对客户端数据异构性对全局模型泛化误差的影响进行了理论分析。其次，基于理论分析，建立了一个优化问题，旨在联合最小化学习延迟和能耗，同时约束泛化误差。最后，提出了一种联合客户端选择和资源分配（CSRA）方法，该方法利用一系列凸优化和松弛技术来解决优化问题。
AI.result: 提出的联合客户端选择和资源分配（CSRA）方案在仿真中表现出更高的测试准确性、更低的学习延迟和更低的能耗，优于未考虑数据异构性的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过感知数据异构性并采用联合客户端选择和资源分配（CSRA）方案，可以有效提高无线网络中联邦学习的测试准确性，并显著降低学习延迟和能耗。
AI.translation: 联邦学习（FL）使移动边缘设备（作为客户端）能够协同训练去中心化模型，同时确保本地数据隐私。然而，FL在无线网络中的效率不仅受到通信和计算资源限制的影响，还受到客户端之间显著数据异构性的制约，尤其是在大规模网络中。本文首先对客户端数据异构性对全局模型泛化误差的影响进行了理论分析，这种影响可能导致重复训练周期、增加能耗和延长延迟。基于这些理论洞察，本文提出了一个优化问题，旨在联合最小化学习延迟和能耗，同时约束泛化误差。随后，提出了一种联合客户端选择和资源分配（CSRA）方法，该方法采用了一系列凸优化和松弛技术。广泛的仿真结果表明，与未考虑数据异构性的基线方法相比，所提出的CSRA方案产生了更高的测试准确性、更低的学习延迟和更低的能耗。
AI.summary: 本文针对无线网络中联邦学习（FL）因数据异构性导致的效率限制问题，首先进行了理论分析以量化其对模型泛化误差的影响。基于此，文章构建了一个优化问题，旨在联合最小化学习延迟和能耗，同时约束泛化误差。作者提出了一种联合客户端选择和资源分配（CSRA）方法，并利用凸优化技术进行求解。仿真结果表明，CSRA方案在准确性和效率方面均优于不考虑数据异构性的基线方法。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习,数据异构性,客户端选择,资源分配,无线网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首先对客户端数据异构性对全局模型泛化误差的影响进行了理论分析，并将这一理论洞察集成到实际的工程优化问题中。通过提出联合客户端选择和资源分配（CSRA）方法，该研究提供了一个全面的框架，用于解决大规模无线网络中联邦学习（FL）在效率和准确性方面的关键限制，即数据异构性。这对于推动FL在边缘计算环境中的实际部署具有重要意义。

title: Real-world Reinforcement Learning from Suboptimal Interventions
summary: Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising approach to training precise and dexterous robotic manipulation policies in an online manner, enabling robots to learn from their own experience while gradually reducing human labor. However, prior real-world RL methods often assume that human interventions are optimal across the entire state space, overlooking the fact that even expert operators cannot consistently provide optimal actions in all states or completely avoid mistakes. Indiscriminately mixing intervention data with robot-collected data inherits the sample inefficiency of RL, while purely imitating intervention data can ultimately degrade the final performance achievable by RL. The question of how to leverage potentially suboptimal and noisy human interventions to accelerate learning without being constrained by them thus remains open. To address this challenge, we propose SiLRI, a state-wise Lagrangian reinforcement learning algorithm for real-world robot manipulation tasks. Specifically, we formulate the online manipulation problem as a constrained RL optimization, where the constraint bound at each state is determined by the uncertainty of human interventions. We then introduce a state-wise Lagrange multiplier and solve the problem via a min-max optimization, jointly optimizing the policy and the Lagrange multiplier to reach a saddle point. Built upon a human-as-copilot teleoperation system, our algorithm is evaluated through real-world experiments on diverse manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that SiLRI effectively exploits human suboptimal interventions, reducing the time required to reach a 90% success rate by at least 50% compared with the state-of-the-art RL method HIL-SERL, and achieving a 100% success rate on long-horizon manipulation tasks where other RL methods struggle to succeed. Project website: https://silri-rl.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: 基于次优干预的真实世界强化学习
AI.tldr: 针对真实世界RL中人类干预次优的问题，本文提出了SiLRI算法。它使用状态感知拉格朗日受限优化来有效利用次优干预数据，在实际机器人操作任务中将达到高成功率所需时间缩短了至少50%，并解决了其他方法难以成功的长时程任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的真实世界强化学习（RL）方法通常假设人类干预是全局最优的，但这与现实不符，因为即使是专家也可能提供次优或有误的动作。如何利用潜在次优且带有噪声的人类干预来加速学习而不受其限制，是一个悬而未决的问题。
AI.method: 提出SiLRI（一种状态感知拉格朗日强化学习算法）。将在线操作问题表述为受限RL优化，其中每个状态的约束边界由人类干预的不确定性决定。通过引入状态感知拉格朗日乘数，使用最小-最大优化来共同优化策略和乘数以达到鞍点。
AI.result: 在真实世界操作任务中，SiLRI有效利用了次优干预，与最先进的HIL-SERL方法相比，达到90%成功率所需时间减少了至少50%。在其他RL方法难以成功的长时程操作任务上实现了100%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: SiLRI通过将人类干预的不确定性纳入状态感知约束，成功地利用了次优人类干预来显著加速真实世界机器人操作任务的学习，并提高了最终性能。
AI.translation: 真实世界强化学习（RL）提供了一种有前景的方法，可以以在线方式训练精确灵巧的机器人操作策略，使机器人能够从自身经验中学习，同时逐渐减少人力。然而，先前的真实世界RL方法通常假设人类干预在整个状态空间中都是最优的，忽略了即使是专家操作员也无法在所有状态下始终提供最优动作或完全避免错误的事实。不加区分地将干预数据与机器人收集的数据混合，会继承RL的样本低效性，而单纯模仿干预数据最终可能会降低RL可达到的最终性能。因此，如何利用潜在次优且带有噪声的人类干预来加速学习而不受其限制的问题仍然悬而未决。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了SiLRI，这是一种用于真实世界机器人操作任务的状态感知拉格朗日强化学习算法。具体来说，我们将在线操作问题表述为受限RL优化，其中每个状态的约束边界由人类干预的不确定性决定。然后，我们引入一个状态感知拉格朗日乘数，并通过最小-最大优化来解决该问题，联合优化策略和拉格朗日乘数以达到鞍点。我们的算法建立在“人类作为副驾驶”的遥操作系统之上，并通过真实世界实验在各种操作任务上进行了评估。实验结果表明，SiLRI有效利用了人类的次优干预，与最先进的RL方法HIL-SERL相比，将达到90%成功率所需时间减少了至少50%，并在其他RL方法难以成功的长时程操作任务上实现了100%的成功率。项目网站：https://silri-rl.github.io/。
AI.summary: SiLRI是一种用于真实世界机器人操作的状态感知拉格朗日强化学习算法。它解决了传统RL方法无法有效利用次优人类干预数据的挑战。通过将问题建模为受限RL优化，并使用人类干预不确定性来确定状态约束，SiLRI通过最小-最大优化来联合学习策略和拉格朗日乘数。实验证明，SiLRI比现有SOTA方法显著加快了学习速度，并在复杂任务中实现了完美成功率。
AI.keywords: 真实世界强化学习, 次优干预, 受限强化学习, 拉格朗日, 机器人操作
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个状态感知的受限强化学习框架（SiLRI），以解决真实世界RL中次优人类干预的利用问题。通过将人类干预的不确定性转化为状态约束边界，该方法有效地平衡了从人类经验中加速学习和避免被次优数据限制之间的矛盾。这种对人类数据不完美性的显式建模，对于提高真实世界机器人学习的实用性和样本效率具有重要意义。

title: Automated Analysis of Sustainability Reports: Using Large Language Models for the Extraction and Prediction of EU Taxonomy-Compliant KPIs
summary: The manual, resource-intensive process of complying with the EU Taxonomy presents a significant challenge for companies. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a path to automation, research is hindered by a lack of public benchmark datasets. To address this gap, we introduce a novel, structured dataset from 190 corporate reports, containing ground-truth economic activities and quantitative Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). We use this dataset to conduct the first systematic evaluation of LLMs on the core compliance workflow. Our results reveal a clear performance gap between qualitative and quantitative tasks. LLMs show moderate success in the qualitative task of identifying economic activities, with a multi-step agentic framework modestly enhancing precision. Conversely, the models comprehensively fail at the quantitative task of predicting financial KPIs in a zero-shot setting. We also discover a paradox, where concise metadata often yields superior performance to full, unstructured reports, and find that model confidence scores are poorly calibrated. We conclude that while LLMs are not ready for full automation, they can serve as powerful assistive tools for human experts. Our dataset provides a public benchmark for future research.

AI.title_translation: 自动化可持续性报告分析：使用大型语言模型提取和预测欧盟分类法合规的关键绩效指标
AI.tldr: 该研究引入了一个新的数据集，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在欧盟分类法合规性方面的能力。结果表明，LLM在识别经济活动等定性任务上表现尚可，但在预测财务关键绩效指标等定量任务上表现不佳。研究还发现，简洁的元数据有时比完整的报告效果更好，并且模型的置信度得分不准确。结论是，LLM目前不能完全自动化此过程，但可作为人类专家的辅助工具。该数据集可作为未来研究的基准。
AI.motivation: 手动分析和遵守欧盟分类法是一个耗时且资源密集的过程。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）有潜力实现自动化，但缺乏公开的基准数据集阻碍了相关研究。本研究旨在通过引入一个包含真实经济活动和量化关键绩效指标（KPI）的新型结构化数据集来解决这一问题，并系统地评估LLM在核心合规流程中的表现。
AI.method: 研究人员构建了一个包含190份公司报告的新型结构化数据集，其中包含真实的经济活动和量化的关键绩效指标（KPI）。他们利用这个数据集对LLM在识别经济活动（定性任务）和预测财务KPI（定量任务）方面的表现进行了首次系统评估，并探索了多步代理框架和不同数据格式（如简洁元数据与完整报告）的影响，同时分析了模型置信度得分的准确性。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，LLM在定性任务（识别经济活动）上表现出中等成功率，使用多步代理框架可以适度提高精确度。然而，在零样本设置下，LLM在定量任务（预测财务KPI）上则完全失败。此外，研究还发现，简洁的元数据在某些情况下比完整的非结构化报告能带来更好的性能，并且模型的置信度得分校准不佳。
AI.conclusion: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）目前尚未准备好实现欧盟分类法合规性分析的完全自动化，但它们可以作为人类专家的有力辅助工具。本研究提供了一个公共数据集，为未来的相关研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 手动、资源密集型的合规流程对公司来说是一个重大的挑战。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）为自动化提供了一条途径，但研究因缺乏公开的基准数据集而受到阻碍。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个包含190份公司报告的新型结构化数据集，其中包含真实的经济活动和量化的关键绩效指标（KPI）。我们利用这个数据集对LLM在核心合规工作流程中的表现进行了首次系统评估。我们的结果显示，定性任务和定量任务之间存在明显的性能差距。LLM在识别经济活动的定性任务上取得了中等成功，而多步代理框架则适度提高了精确度。相反，模型在零样本设置下预测财务KPI的定量任务上则完全失败。我们还发现了一个悖论，即简洁的元数据通常比完整、非结构化的报告产生更好的性能，并且发现模型置信度得分的校准效果不佳。我们得出结论，虽然LLM尚未准备好实现完全自动化，但它们可以作为人类专家的强大辅助工具。我们的数据集为未来的研究提供了公共基准。
AI.summary: 本研究针对欧盟分类法合规性分析中的自动化挑战，引入了一个包含190份公司报告的新型结构化数据集。研究评估了大型语言模型（LLM）在定性任务（识别经济活动）和定量任务（预测财务KPI）上的表现。结果显示，LLM在定性任务上表现尚可，但定量任务上表现不佳。研究还发现简洁元数据优于完整报告，且模型置信度得分不准确。最终结论是，LLM可作为辅助工具，但不能完全自动化此过程，并强调了该数据集作为未来研究基准的重要性。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型,欧盟分类法,可持续性报告,关键绩效指标,自动化分析
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入一个公开的数据集，为评估LLM在可持续性报告分析领域的应用提供了重要的基准。研究结果揭示了LLM在处理定性和定量信息时的能力差异，以及在实际应用中可能遇到的挑战，如数据格式和模型置信度问题。这些发现对于指导未来LLM在金融和可持续性报告领域的研发具有重要意义，同时也强调了在完全自动化之前，人类专家的监督仍然是必要的。

title: Virtual-Eyes: Quantitative Validation of a Lung CT Quality-Control Pipeline for Foundation-Model Cancer Risk Prediction
summary: Robust preprocessing is rarely quantified in deep-learning pipelines for low-dose CT (LDCT) lung cancer screening. We develop and validate Virtual-Eyes, a clinically motivated 16-bit CT quality-control pipeline, and measure its differential impact on generalist foundation models versus specialist models. Virtual-Eyes enforces strict 512x512 in-plane resolution, rejects short or non-diagnostic series, and extracts a contiguous lung block using Hounsfield-unit filtering and bilateral lung-coverage scoring while preserving the native 16-bit grid. Using 765 NLST patients (182 cancer, 583 non-cancer), we compute slice-level embeddings from RAD-DINO and Merlin with frozen encoders and train leakage-free patient-level MLP heads; we also evaluate Sybil and a 2D ResNet-18 baseline under Raw versus Virtual-Eyes inputs without backbone retraining. Virtual-Eyes improves RAD-DINO slice-level AUC from 0.576 to 0.610 and patient-level AUC from 0.646 to 0.683 (mean pooling) and from 0.619 to 0.735 (max pooling), with improved calibration (Brier score 0.188 to 0.112). In contrast, Sybil and ResNet-18 degrade under Virtual-Eyes (Sybil AUC 0.886 to 0.837; ResNet-18 AUC 0.571 to 0.596) with evidence of context dependence and shortcut learning, and Merlin shows limited transferability (AUC approximately 0.507 to 0.567) regardless of preprocessing. These results demonstrate that anatomically targeted QC can stabilize and improve generalist foundation-model workflows but may disrupt specialist models adapted to raw clinical context.

AI.title_translation: 虚拟之眼：用于基础模型癌症风险预测的肺部 CT 质量控制流程的量化验证
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为 Virtual-Eyes 的肺部 CT 图像质量控制（QC）流程，并量化了它对不同类型的深度学习模型（包括通用基础模型和专用模型）在肺癌风险预测任务上的影响。结果表明，Virtual-Eyes 能够稳定并提升通用基础模型的性能，但可能会干扰那些已经适应了原始临床数据特征的专用模型。
AI.motivation: 在用于低剂量 CT（LDCT）肺癌筛查的深度学习流程中，很少对鲁棒的预处理进行量化。本研究旨在开发和验证一个临床驱动的 CT 质量控制流程（Virtual-Eyes），并衡量其对通用基础模型和专用模型的影响。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为 Virtual-Eyes 的 16 位 CT 质量控制流程，该流程强制执行 512x512 的平面分辨率，剔除过短或非诊断性的图像序列，并使用 Hounsfield 单位过滤和双侧肺覆盖评分提取连续的肺部区域，同时保留了原始的 16 位数据。使用 765 名 NLST 患者的数据，在原始数据和 Virtual-Eyes 处理后的数据上，分别评估了 RAD-DINO、Merlin、Sybil 和 ResNet-18 等模型在肺癌风险预测任务上的表现。
AI.result: Virtual-Eyes 能够提升 RAD-DINO 通用基础模型的性能，包括在切片级和患者级的 AUC（分别为 0.576 提高到 0.610，0.646 提高到 0.683/0.735），并改善其校准性（Brier score 从 0.188 降至 0.112）。然而，对于 Sybil 和 ResNet-18 等专用模型，Virtual-Eyes 处理反而导致性能下降（Sybil AUC 从 0.886 降至 0.837，ResNet-18 AUC 从 0.571 升至 0.596），表明存在上下文依赖和捷径学习问题。Merlin 模型在不同预处理下的性能均不佳。
AI.conclusion: 解剖学上目标明确的质量控制（QC）流程可以稳定并提升通用基础模型在肺癌风险预测工作流中的性能，但可能会干扰那些已经适应了原始临床数据特征的专用模型。
AI.translation: 鲁棒的预处理很少在低剂量 CT (LDCT) 肺癌筛查的深度学习流程中被量化。我们开发并验证了 Virtual-Eyes，一个临床驱动的 16 位 CT 质量控制流程，并测量了它对通用基础模型与专用模型产生的差异化影响。Virtual-Eyes 强制执行严格的 512x512 平面分辨率，拒绝过短或非诊断性的序列，并通过 Hounsfield 单位过滤和双侧肺覆盖评分提取连续的肺部区域，同时保留原始的 16 位网格。我们利用 765 名 NLST 患者（182 名癌症患者，583 名非癌症患者），从具有冻结编码器的 RAD-DINO 和 Merlin 中计算切片级嵌入，并训练无泄漏的患者级 MLP 头部；我们还在没有骨干网络重新训练的情况下，评估了 Sybil 和一个 2D ResNet-18 基线在原始输入与 Virtual-Eyes 输入下的表现。Virtual-Eyes 将 RAD-DINO 的切片级 AUC 从 0.576 提高到 0.610，患者级 AUC 从 0.646 提高到 0.683（平均池化）和从 0.619 提高到 0.735（最大池化），并改善了校准性（Brier score 从 0.188 降至 0.112）。相比之下，Sybil 和 ResNet-18 在 Virtual-Eyes 下性能下降（Sybil AUC 从 0.886 降至 0.837；ResNet-18 AUC 从 0.571 升至 0.596），并有上下文依赖和捷径学习的证据，而 Merlin 在无论何种预处理下转移性均表现有限（AUC 约为 0.507 至 0.567）。这些结果表明，解剖学上目标明确的 QC 能够稳定并改善通用基础模型的工作流，但可能会干扰适应了原始临床背景的专用模型。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了 Virtual-Eyes，一个用于肺部 CT 图像质量控制的 16 位流程，旨在量化其对不同深度学习模型在肺癌风险预测中的影响。研究发现，该流程能提升通用基础模型（如 RAD-DINO）的性能和校准性，但却降低了专用模型（如 Sybil 和 ResNet-18）的性能，这可能归因于上下文依赖和捷径学习。研究强调了针对不同模型类型进行量化评估的重要性。
AI.keywords: 肺部 CT, 质量控制, 深度学习, 基础模型, 癌症风险预测
AI.comments: 这项研究非常有价值，它量化了预处理流程对不同类型深度学习模型在肺癌风险预测任务上的影响，特别是区分了通用基础模型和专用模型。研究结果揭示了预处理的“双刃剑”效应——对通用模型有益，却可能干扰专用模型。这为未来开发更有效的 CT 图像分析管线提供了重要的指导，但也指出了需要进一步研究模型对数据变化的敏感性和鲁棒性，以及如何设计能够同时适应不同模型需求的预处理策略。

title: Figure It Out: Improving the Frontier of Reasoning with Active Visual Thinking
summary: Complex reasoning problems often involve implicit spatial, geometric, and structural relationships that are not explicitly encoded in text. While recent reasoning models have achieved strong performance across many domains, purely text-based reasoning struggles to represent global structural constraints in complex settings. In this paper, we introduce FIGR, which integrates active visual thinking into multi-turn reasoning via end-to-end reinforcement learning. FIGR externalizes intermediate structural hypotheses by constructing visual representations during problem solving. By adaptively regulating when and how visual reasoning should be invoked, FIGR enables more stable and coherent reasoning over global structural properties that are difficult to capture from text alone. Experiments on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that FIGR outperforms strong text-only chain-of-thought baselines. In particular, FIGR improves the base model by 13.12% on AIME 2025 and 11.00% on BeyondAIME, highlighting the effectiveness of figure-guided multimodal reasoning in enhancing the stability and reliability of complex reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 弄清楚：通过主动视觉思维提高推理的前沿水平
AI.tldr: FIGR通过引入“主动视觉思维”并使用强化学习来生成和利用中间视觉表示，成功解决了纯文本推理难以处理复杂结构约束的问题，从而在高级数学推理任务上显著超越了现有的思维链方法。
AI.motivation: 复杂的推理问题通常涉及文本中未明确编码的隐式空间、几何和结构关系；纯文本推理在复杂场景中难以有效表示全局结构约束。
AI.method: 引入FIGR模型，通过端到端强化学习将主动视觉思维整合到多轮推理中，在问题解决过程中构建视觉表示以外部化中间结构假设，并自适应地调节视觉推理的调用时机和方式。
AI.result: FIGR在AIME 2025上比基线模型提高了13.12%，在BeyondAIME上提高了11.00%，证明了图引导的多模态推理在增强复杂推理的稳定性和可靠性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: FIGR通过将主动视觉思维整合到多轮推理中，提高了复杂推理的稳定性和可靠性，在具有挑战性的数学推理基准上优于强大的纯文本思维链基线。
AI.translation: 复杂推理问题通常涉及未在文本中明确编码的隐式空间、几何和结构关系。虽然最近的推理模型在许多领域都取得了强大的性能，但纯文本推理在复杂设置中难以表示全局结构约束。在本文中，我们引入了FIGR，它通过端到端强化学习将主动视觉思维整合到多轮推理中。FIGR通过在解决问题的过程中构建视觉表示来外部化中间结构假设。通过自适应地调节何时以及如何调用视觉推理，FIGR使得对仅从文本中难以捕获的全局结构属性的推理更加稳定和连贯。在具有挑战性的数学推理基准上的实验表明，FIGR优于强大的纯文本思维链基线。特别是，FIGR在AIME 2025上使基线模型提高了13.12%，在BeyondAIME上提高了11.00%，突出了图引导的多模态推理在增强复杂推理的稳定性和可靠性方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FIGR模型，它通过端到端强化学习将主动视觉思维融入多轮推理。FIGR通过生成和利用中间视觉表示来显式处理复杂的空间和结构约束，从而克服了纯文本推理的局限性，并在数学推理任务上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 主动视觉思维, 视觉推理, 结构约束, 强化学习, 多模态推理
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“主动视觉思维”的概念，并通过端到端强化学习将其整合到多轮推理中，以解决纯文本推理难以捕捉全局结构约束的问题。其重要性在于显著提升了在复杂数学推理任务上的表现。限制在于仅在数学推理基准上进行了实验。

title: World In Your Hands: A Large-Scale and Open-source Ecosystem for Learning Human-centric Manipulation in the Wild
summary: Large-scale pre-training is fundamental for generalization in language and vision models, but data for dexterous hand manipulation remains limited in scale and diversity, hindering policy generalization. Limited scenario diversity, misaligned modalities, and insufficient benchmarking constrain current human manipulation datasets. To address these gaps, we introduce World In Your Hands (WiYH), a large-scale open-source ecosystem for human-centric manipulation learning. WiYH includes (1) the Oracle Suite, a wearable data collection kit with an auto-labeling pipeline for accurate motion capture; (2) the WiYH Dataset, featuring over 1,000 hours of multi-modal manipulation data across hundreds of skills in diverse real-world scenarios; and (3) extensive annotations and benchmarks supporting tasks from perception to action. Furthermore, experiments based on the WiYH ecosystem show that integrating WiYH's human-centric data significantly enhances the generalization and robustness of dexterous hand policies in tabletop manipulation tasks. We believe that World In Your Hands will bring new insights into human-centric data collection and policy learning to the community.

AI.title_translation: 掌握在你手中：一个用于在野外学习以人为中心的操控的大规模开源生态系统
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为“掌握在你手中”（WiYH）的大规模开源生态系统，用于收集和学习以人为中心的操控数据，解决了现有数据集规模小、多样性不足的问题。该生态系统包括一个数据收集套件、一个包含1000多小时多模态数据的WiYH数据集，以及广泛的标注和基准测试。实验证明，使用WiYH数据能显著提升操控策略的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的人手操控数据集在规模、多样性、场景覆盖、模态对齐和基准测试方面存在不足，阻碍了操控策略的泛化能力。
AI.method: 研究提出了“掌握在你手中”（WiYH）生态系统，包括：1. Oracle Suite：一个可穿戴数据收集套件，带有自动标注流水线，用于精确的动作捕捉。2. WiYH数据集：包含1000多小时的多模态操控数据，涵盖数百种技能和多样化的真实世界场景。3. 广泛的标注和基准测试，支持从感知到动作的各种任务。
AI.result: 基于WiYH生态系统的实验表明，整合WiYH以人为中心的数据显著提高了操控策略在桌面操控任务上的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: WiYH生态系统有望为社区在以人为中心的数据收集和策略学习方面带来新的见解。
AI.translation: 大规模预训练对于语言和视觉模型的泛化至关重要，但灵巧手部操控的数据在规模和多样性方面仍然有限，阻碍了策略的泛化。有限的场景多样性、不匹配的模态以及不足的基准测试限制了当前的人类操控数据集。为了解决这些差距，我们引入了“掌握在你手中”（WiYH），一个大规模的、开源的、以人为中心的操控学习生态系统。WiYH包括（1）Oracle Suite，一个带有自动标注流水线的可穿戴数据收集套件，用于精确的动作捕捉；（2）WiYH数据集，包含跨越数百种技能和多样化真实世界场景的1000多小时多模态操控数据；以及（3）支持从感知到动作任务的广泛标注和基准测试。此外，基于WiYH生态系统的实验表明，整合WiYH的以人为中心的数据显著增强了灵巧手部策略在桌面操控任务上的泛化能力和鲁棒性。我们相信，“掌握在你手中”将为社区带来关于以人为中心的数据收集和策略学习的新见解。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了“掌握在你手中”（WiYH）生态系统，通过提供大规模、多样化且标注丰富的数据集和工具，解决了当前人类操控学习中数据稀疏和泛化能力不足的问题。该生态系统包括数据收集套件、包含1000多小时多模态数据的WiYH数据集，以及全面的标注和基准测试，旨在促进以人为中心的操控策略研究。
AI.keywords: 人类操控, 数据集, 开源生态系统, 策略学习, 动作捕捉
AI.comments: 该研究在解决大规模、多样化人类操控数据收集的挑战方面取得了重要进展，通过构建一个全面的开源生态系统，为该领域的研究做出了贡献。然而，其在真实世界复杂场景中的应用和扩展性仍有待进一步验证。

title: QianfanHuijin Technical Report: A Novel Multi-Stage Training Paradigm for Finance Industrial LLMs
summary:
Domain-specific enhancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) within the financial context has long been a focal point of industrial application. While previous models such as BloombergGPT and Baichuan-Finance primarily focused on knowledge enhancement, the deepening complexity of financial services has driven a growing demand for models that possess not only domain knowledge but also robust financial reasoning and agentic capabilities. In this paper, we present QianfanHuijin, a financial domain LLM, and propose a generalizable multi-stage training paradigm for industrial model enhancement.
  Our approach begins with Continual Pre-training (CPT) on financial corpora to consolidate the knowledge base. This is followed by a fine-grained Post-training pipeline designed with increasing specificity: starting with Financial SFT, progressing to Finance Reasoning RL and Finance Agentic RL, and culminating in General RL aligned with real-world business scenarios. Empirical results demonstrate that QianfanHuijin achieves superior performance across various authoritative financial benchmarks. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm that the targeted Reasoning RL and Agentic RL stages yield significant gains in their respective capabilities. These findings validate our motivation and suggest that this fine-grained, progressive post-training methodology is poised to become a mainstream paradigm for various industrial-enhanced LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 千帆汇金技术报告：一种新颖的金融行业大语言模型多阶段训练范式
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了千帆汇金模型，一个针对金融领域的大语言模型，并引入了一种通用的多阶段训练范式，包括持续预训练（CPT）、金融指令微调（SFT）、金融推理强化学习（RL）和金融智能体RL，最终在真实业务场景下进行通用RL对齐。实验证明该模型在金融基准测试中表现优异，且推理和智能体RL阶段对提升相应能力至关重要，预示着这种精细化的渐进式后训练方法可能成为工业增强LLM的主流范式。
AI.motivation: 随着金融服务复杂性的增加，对具备领域知识、金融推理能力和智能体能力的大语言模型（LLMs）的需求日益增长，而不仅仅是知识增强。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一种通用的多阶段训练范式：首先对金融语料进行持续预训练（CPT）以巩固知识库，然后进行精细化的后训练，包括金融SFT、金融推理RL和金融智能体RL，最后在真实业务场景下进行通用RL对齐。
AI.result: QianfanHuijin模型在多个权威金融基准测试中取得了优越的性能。消融研究证实，推理RL和智能体RL阶段显著提升了各自的能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出的精细化、渐进式后训练方法，通过多阶段的训练范式，能够有效提升金融领域大语言模型的知识、推理和智能体能力，并有望成为工业增强LLM的主流范式。
AI.translation:
领域特定的大语言模型（LLMs）在金融领域的工业应用一直是人们关注的焦点。虽然像BloombergGPT和百川金融这样的模型主要侧重于知识增强，但金融服务的复杂性日益增加，推动了对不仅拥有领域知识，还具备强大金融推理和智能体能力模型的日益增长的需求。在本研究中，我们提出了千帆汇金（QianfanHuijin），一个金融领域的大语言模型，并提出了一种通用的多阶段训练范式，用于工业模型增强。
我们的方法首先在金融语料上进行持续预训练（CPT），以巩固知识库。随后，我们设计了一个由粗到细的后训练流程，其具体性逐渐增强：从金融SFT开始，逐步进行金融推理RL和金融智能体RL，最终在真实业务场景下进行通用RL对齐。实证结果表明，千帆汇金在各种权威金融基准测试中均取得了优越的性能。此外，消融研究证实了有针对性的推理RL和智能体RL阶段在各自能力方面产生了显著的提升。这些发现验证了我们的动机，并表明这种精细化的、渐进式的后训练方法有望成为各种工业增强LLM的主流范式。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了千帆汇金（QianfanHuijin）模型，一个为金融领域量身定制的大语言模型。该模型采用了一种创新的多阶段训练范式，首先通过持续预训练（CPT）巩固金融知识，然后分阶段进行指令微调（SFT）、推理强化学习（RL）和智能体强化学习（RL），最后在真实业务场景下进行对齐。实验结果表明，千帆汇金在金融基准测试中表现出色，并且推理和智能体RL阶段的有效性得到了验证，该范式有望成为未来工业增强大语言模型的主流方法。
AI.keywords: 金融大语言模型, 多阶段训练, 推理能力, 智能体能力, 持续预训练
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的多阶段训练范式，用于增强金融领域的大语言模型，解决了现有模型仅侧重知识增强的局限性。通过结合持续预训练、指令微调以及专门的推理和智能体强化学习阶段，该方法有效地提升了模型的综合能力。实验结果和消融研究提供了有力的证据支持其有效性。该范式具有通用性，有望推广到其他工业领域。然而，对于训练成本、模型的可解释性以及在真实金融业务中的长期部署效果，可能需要进一步的探讨。

title: UniAct: Unified Motion Generation and Action Streaming for Humanoid Robots
summary: A long-standing objective in humanoid robotics is the realization of versatile agents capable of following diverse multimodal instructions with human-level flexibility. Despite advances in humanoid control, bridging high-level multimodal perception with whole-body execution remains a significant bottleneck. Existing methods often struggle to translate heterogeneous instructions -- such as language, music, and trajectories -- into stable, real-time actions. Here we show that UniAct, a two-stage framework integrating a fine-tuned MLLM with a causal streaming pipeline, enables humanoid robots to execute multimodal instructions with sub-500 ms latency. By unifying inputs through a shared discrete codebook via FSQ, UniAct ensures cross-modal alignment while constraining motions to a physically grounded manifold. This approach yields a 19% improvement in the success rate of zero-shot tracking of imperfect reference motions. We validate UniAct on UniMoCap, our 20-hour humanoid motion benchmark, demonstrating robust generalization across diverse real-world scenarios. Our results mark a critical step toward responsive, general-purpose humanoid assistants capable of seamless interaction through unified perception and control.

AI.title_translation: 统一动作：人形机器人的统一运动生成和动作流
AI.tldr: UniAct是一个两阶段框架，通过微调的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和因果流式处理管道，使人形机器人能够以低于500毫秒的延迟执行多模态指令，通过共享离散码本实现跨模态对齐和物理约束运动，在零样本参考运动跟踪中成功率提高了19%，并在UniMoCap基准测试中展示了鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 实现能够遵循多样化多模态指令并具有人类级别灵活性的通用人形机器人代理，解决当前人形机器人控制在高层多模态感知与全身执行之间存在的瓶颈问题，克服现有方法在将异构指令（如语言、音乐、轨迹）转化为稳定、实时动作方面的困难。
AI.method: UniAct采用两阶段框架：第一阶段，利用微调的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）处理和理解异构指令；第二阶段，通过因果流式处理管道将指令转化为机器人的动作。该框架使用全矢量量化（FSQ）的共享离散码本来统一输入，实现跨模态对齐，并将运动约束在物理上可行的流形上。
AI.result: UniAct实现了低于500毫秒的延迟，在零样本参考运动跟踪任务中成功率提高了19%，并在UniMoCap（一个20小时的人形运动基准）上进行了验证，展示了在各种真实世界场景中的鲁棒泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: UniAct通过整合微调的多模态大语言模型和因果流式处理管道，成功实现了人形机器人对多模态指令的统一运动生成和动作流，显著提高了指令执行的效率和鲁棒性，是迈向响应迅速、通用的、能够通过统一感知和控制进行无缝交互的人形机器人助手的关键一步。
AI.translation: 一个长期存在的人形机器人目标是实现能够以人类级别的灵活性遵循多样化多模态指令的通用代理。尽管人形机器人控制取得了进展，但将高层多模态感知与全身执行相结合仍然是一个重大的瓶颈。现有方法常常难以将异构指令（如语言、音乐和轨迹）转化为稳定、实时的动作。在这里，我们展示了UniAct，一个整合了微调的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和因果流式处理管道的两阶段框架，使人形机器人能够以低于500毫秒的延迟执行多模态指令。通过FSQ的共享离散码本统一输入，UniAct确保了跨模态对齐，同时将运动约束在物理上可行的流形上。这种方法在零样本跟踪不完美的参考运动方面，成功率提高了19%。我们在UniMoCap上验证了UniAct，这是一个20小时的人形运动基准，展示了在各种真实世界场景中的鲁棒泛化能力。我们的结果标志着朝着能够通过统一感知和控制进行无缝交互的、响应迅速的、通用的人形机器人助手迈出了关键一步。
AI.summary: UniAct是一个创新的两阶段框架，旨在解决人形机器人执行多模态指令的挑战。它通过利用微调的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）来理解指令，并结合因果流式处理管道生成动作，实现了低于500毫秒的低延迟。该框架的核心在于使用FSQ的共享离散码本，这不仅统一了不同模态的输入，还确保了跨模态的对齐，并将生成的运动约束在物理上可行的范围内。实验结果表明，UniAct在零样本参考运动跟踪任务中取得了19%的成功率提升，并在UniMoCap基准测试中展现了良好的泛化能力，为开发更通用、更具交互性的人形机器人助手奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: UniAct, 人形机器人, 多模态指令, 运动生成, 流式处理
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为UniAct的统一框架，有效地解决了人形机器人理解和执行多模态指令的长期挑战。其创新之处在于结合了MLLM和流式处理管道，并通过FSQ实现跨模态对齐和物理约束，这在理论和实践上都具有重要意义。然而，该框架在实际应用中的可扩展性和对复杂、模糊指令的处理能力仍有待进一步探索。此外，UniMoCap基准的构建和使用也为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。

title: Robust Egocentric Referring Video Object Segmentation via Dual-Modal Causal Intervention
summary: Egocentric Referring Video Object Segmentation (Ego-RVOS) aims to segment the specific object actively involved in a human action, as described by a language query, within first-person videos. This task is critical for understanding egocentric human behavior. However, achieving such segmentation robustly is challenging due to ambiguities inherent in egocentric videos and biases present in training data. Consequently, existing methods often struggle, learning spurious correlations from skewed object-action pairings in datasets and fundamental visual confounding factors of the egocentric perspective, such as rapid motion and frequent occlusions. To address these limitations, we introduce Causal Ego-REferring Segmentation (CERES), a plug-in causal framework that adapts strong, pre-trained RVOS backbones to the egocentric domain. CERES implements dual-modal causal intervention: applying backdoor adjustment principles to counteract language representation biases learned from dataset statistics, and leveraging front-door adjustment concepts to address visual confounding by intelligently integrating semantic visual features with geometric depth information guided by causal principles, creating representations more robust to egocentric distortions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CERES achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ego-RVOS benchmarks, highlighting the potential of applying causal reasoning to build more reliable models for broader egocentric video understanding.

AI.title_translation: 通过双模态因果干预实现鲁棒的自上而下的指代视频目标分割
AI.tldr: 为了使第一人称视频目标分割（Ego-RVOS）更鲁棒，我们提出了CERES框架，它使用因果干预（同时处理语言和视觉的混淆因素）来修复预训练模型，并在基准测试中取得了SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的Ego-RVOS方法难以稳健地实现分割，因为它们会学习到由不平衡的对象-动作配对产生的数据集偏差，以及由第一人称视角（如快速运动和频繁遮挡）带来的根本视觉混淆因素。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为CERES（Causal Ego-REferring Segmentation）的即插即用因果框架，它通过双模态因果干预来调整预训练的RVOS骨干网络。具体包括：应用后门调整原则来对抗由数据集统计信息引起的语言表示偏差；利用前门调整概念，通过因果原则指导，智能地整合语义视觉特征和几何深度信息来解决视觉混淆因素。
AI.result: CERES在Ego-RVOS基准测试上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: CERES在Ego-RVOS基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，证明了将因果推理应用于构建更可靠的具身视频理解模型的潜力。
AI.translation: 自上而下的指代视频目标分割（Ego-RVOS）旨在从第一人称视频中，根据语言查询描述分割出正在进行人类动作的具体对象。这项任务对于理解自上而下的人类行为至关重要。然而，由于自上而下的视频中固有的歧义以及训练数据中存在的偏差，鲁棒地实现此类分割是具有挑战性的。因此，现有方法往往难以奏效，它们从有偏见的对象-动作配对数据中学习到虚假的关联，以及自上而下视角的根本视觉混淆因素，例如快速运动和频繁的遮挡。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了CERES（Causal Ego-REferring Segmentation），一个即插即用的因果框架，它将强大的、预训练的RVOS骨干网络适配到自上而下的领域。CERES实施了双模态因果干预：应用后门调整原则来抵消从数据集统计数据中学到的语言表示偏差，并利用前门调整概念来解决视觉混淆，通过因果原则指导，智能地整合语义视觉特征和几何深度信息，创建出对自上而下的失真更具鲁棒性的表示。广泛的实验证明，CERES在Ego-RVOS基准测试上实现了最先进的性能，凸显了将因果推理应用于构建更可靠的、用于更广泛的自上而下视频理解模型的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出CERES框架，用于解决第一人称指代视频目标分割（Ego-RVOS）中的鲁棒性问题。CERES通过双模态因果干预（包括后门调整处理语言偏差和前门调整整合深度信息处理视觉混淆）来改进预训练的RVOS模型，实验证明其性能达到最先进水平。
AI.keywords: Egocentric Referring Video Object Segmentation,Causal Intervention,Dual-Modal,Backdoor Adjustment,Front-Door Adjustment
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了“双模态因果干预”机制（后门调整和前门调整）来解决Ego-RVOS中由数据偏差和视点特性（如快速运动、遮挡）带来的鲁棒性问题。其重要性在于将因果推理应用于第一人称视频理解，为构建更可靠的具身智能模型提供了新思路。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但可能依赖于预训练模型和几何深度信息的可用性。

title: Empower Low-Altitude Economy: A Reliability-Aware Dynamic Weighting Allocation for Multi-modal UAV Beam Prediction
summary: The low-altitude economy (LAE) is rapidly expanding driven by urban air mobility, logistics drones, and aerial sensing, while fast and accurate beam prediction in uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) communications is crucial for achieving reliable connectivity. Current research is shifting from single-signal to multi-modal collaborative approaches. However, existing multi-modal methods mostly employ fixed or empirical weights, assuming equal reliability across modalities at any given moment. Indeed, the importance of different modalities fluctuates dramatically with UAV motion scenarios, and static weighting amplifies the negative impact of degraded modalities. Furthermore, modal mismatch and weak alignment further undermine cross-scenario generalization. To this end, we propose a reliability-aware dynamic weighting scheme applied to a semantic-aware multi-modal beam prediction framework, named SaM2B. Specifically, SaM2B leverages lightweight cues such as environmental visual, flight posture, and geospatial data to adaptively allocate contributions across modalities at different time points through reliability-aware dynamic weight updates. Moreover, by utilizing cross-modal contrastive learning, we align the "multi-source representation beam semantics" associated with specific beam information to a shared semantic space, thereby enhancing discriminative power and robustness under modal noise and distribution shifts. Experiments on real-world low-altitude UAV datasets show that SaM2B achieves more satisfactory results than baseline methods.

AI.title_translation: 赋能低空经济：面向多模态无人机波束预测的可靠性感知动态加权分配
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SaM2B的框架，通过动态调整多模态数据（如视觉、姿态、地理空间数据）的权重来提高无人机通信的波束预测可靠性，并利用跨模态对比学习来增强模型在不同场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机通信波束预测方法采用固定或经验性权重，无法适应不同模态在不同飞行场景下的可靠性波动，导致预测性能下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为SaM2B的语义感知多模态波束预测框架，该框架包含一个可靠性感知动态加权方案，利用视觉、飞行姿态和地理空间数据自适应地分配各模态的贡献；同时，利用跨模态对比学习对齐多源表示的波束语义，以增强区分能力和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在真实低空无人机数据集上的实验表明，SaM2B的性能优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的SaM2B框架通过可靠性感知动态加权和跨模态对比学习，能够有效提高低空无人机通信的波束预测精度和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 低空经济（LAE）正迅速扩张，城市空中交通、物流无人机和空中传感是其主要驱动力，而无人机（UAV）通信中快速准确的波束预测对于实现可靠连接至关重要。当前研究正从单一信号转向多模态协同方法。然而，现有的多模态方法大多采用固定的或经验性的权重，假设不同模态在任何给定时刻都具有相等的可靠性。事实上，不同模态的重要性会随着无人机的运动场景而剧烈波动，静态加权会放大退化模态的负面影响。此外，模态不匹配和对齐不充分会进一步削弱跨场景的泛化能力。为此，我们提出了一种应用于语义感知多模态波束预测框架（命名为SaM2B）的可靠性感知动态加权方案。具体而言，SaM2B利用环境视觉、飞行姿态和地理空间数据等轻量级线索，通过可靠性感知的动态权重更新，在不同时间点自适应地分配跨模态的贡献。此外，通过利用跨模态对比学习，我们将与特定波束信息相关的“多源表示波束语义”对齐到一个共享的语义空间，从而增强在模态噪声和分布变化下的区分能力和鲁棒性。真实低空无人机数据集上的实验表明，SaM2B的性能优于基线方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为SaM2B的框架，用于提高低空经济中无人机通信的波束预测可靠性。该框架采用一种新颖的可靠性感知动态加权方案，能够根据环境视觉、飞行姿态和地理空间数据等信息，自适应地调整不同数据模态的贡献比例，以应对通信过程中模态可靠性的动态变化。此外，SaM2B还利用跨模态对比学习技术，将不同来源的波束语义信息映射到统一的语义空间，从而增强模型在模态噪声和分布偏移情况下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。实验结果表明，SaM2B在真实低空无人机数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 低空经济, 多模态通信, 波束预测, 动态加权, 跨模态学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的动态加权方法来解决多模态无人机通信中的波束预测问题，特别关注了不同模态可靠性的动态变化。通过结合语义感知和跨模态对比学习，该方法有望显著提升通信的鲁棒性和准确性。然而，该方法在实际部署中的计算开销和对轻量级线索的依赖性仍需进一步评估。

title: MaRCA: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Computation Allocation in Large-Scale Recommender Systems
summary: Modern recommender systems face significant computational challenges due to growing model complexity and traffic scale, making efficient computation allocation critical for maximizing business revenue. Existing approaches typically simplify multi-stage computation resource allocation, neglecting inter-stage dependencies, thus limiting global optimality. In this paper, we propose MaRCA, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for end-to-end computation resource allocation in large-scale recommender systems. MaRCA models the stages of a recommender system as cooperative agents, using Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) to optimize revenue under computation resource constraints. We introduce an AutoBucket TestBench for accurate computation cost estimation, and a Model Predictive Control (MPC)-based Revenue-Cost Balancer to proactively forecast traffic loads and adjust the revenue-cost trade-off accordingly. Since its end-to-end deployment in the advertising pipeline of a leading global e-commerce platform in November 2024, MaRCA has consistently handled hundreds of billions of ad requests per day and has delivered a 16.67% revenue uplift using existing computation resources.

AI.title_translation: 大规模推荐系统中动态计算分配的多智能体强化学习方法MaRCA
AI.tldr: MaRCA是一个多智能体强化学习框架，用于优化大型推荐系统的动态计算资源分配，解决了传统方法忽略阶段依赖性的问题，通过CTDE优化，并在实际部署中带来了16.67%的收入提升。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统因模型复杂性和流量规模增长而面临巨大的计算挑战，高效的计算分配对于最大化业务收入至关重要。现有方法简化了多阶段资源分配，忽略了阶段间的依赖性，限制了全局最优性。
AI.method: 提出MaRCA框架，将推荐系统阶段建模为合作智能体，采用中心化训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）范式进行优化。引入AutoBucket TestBench进行准确的计算成本估计，并设计了基于模型预测控制（MPC）的收入-成本平衡器来预测流量负载并调整收入-成本权衡。
AI.result: 自2024年11月在一家全球领先电商平台的广告管线中端到端部署以来，MaRCA持续处理每天数百亿次的广告请求，并利用现有计算资源实现了16.67%的收入提升。
AI.conclusion: MaRCA成功地在领先的全球电子商务平台的广告管线中部署，并持续处理每天数千亿次的广告请求，实现了16.67%的收入提升，证明了其在现有计算资源下优化计算分配的有效性。
AI.translation: 现代推荐系统因模型复杂性和流量规模的增长而面临重大的计算挑战，使得高效的计算分配对于最大化业务收入至关重要。现有方法通常简化多阶段计算资源分配，忽略了阶段间的依赖性，从而限制了全局最优性。在本文中，我们提出了MaRCA，一个用于大规模推荐系统端到端计算资源分配的多智能体强化学习框架。MaRCA将推荐系统的各个阶段建模为合作智能体，利用中心化训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）来在计算资源约束下优化收入。我们引入了AutoBucket TestBench以实现准确的计算成本估计，以及一个基于模型预测控制（MPC）的收入-成本平衡器，用以主动预测流量负载并相应地调整收入-成本权衡。自2024年11月在一家领先的全球电子商务平台的广告管线中进行端到端部署以来，MaRCA已持续处理每天数百亿次的广告请求，并利用现有计算资源实现了16.67%的收入提升。
AI.summary: 为解决大规模推荐系统中计算资源分配的复杂性和阶段间依赖性问题，本文提出了MaRCA，一个基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的端到端框架。该框架将系统阶段视为合作智能体，采用CTDE优化资源分配以最大化收入。通过引入AutoBucket TestBench和MPC驱动的收入-成本平衡器，MaRCA在实际部署中实现了显著的收入增长。
AI.keywords: 多智能体强化学习, 动态计算分配, 推荐系统, 资源优化, CTDE
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将推荐系统的多阶段计算资源分配问题建模为一个多智能体强化学习（MARL）问题，并采用了CTDE范式来解决复杂的依赖关系，实现了端到端的优化。结果显示了显著的商业价值（16.67%的收入提升）。局限性可能在于CTDE的训练复杂性以及对AutoBucket TestBench中成本估算准确性的依赖。

title: 3D Path-Following Guidance via Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Fixed-Wing Small UAS
summary: This paper presents the design, implementation, and flight test results of two novel 3D path-following guidance algorithms based on nonlinear model predictive control (MPC), with specific application to fixed-wing small uncrewed aircraft systems. To enable MPC, control-augmented modelling and system identification of the RAAVEN small uncrewed aircraft is presented. Two formulations of MPC are then showcased. The first schedules a static reference path rate over the MPC horizon, incentivizing a constant inertial speed. The second, with inspiration from model predictive contouring control, dynamically optimizes for the reference path rate over the controller horizon as the system operates. This allows for a weighted tradeoff between path progression and distance from path, two competing objectives in path-following guidance. Both controllers are formulated to operate over general smooth 3D arc-length parameterized curves. The MPC guidance algorithms are flown over several high-curvature test paths, with comparison to a baseline lookahead guidance law. The results showcase the real-world feasibility and superior performance of nonlinear MPC for 3D path-following guidance at ground speeds up to 36 meters per second.

AI.title_translation: 基于非线性模型预测控制的固定翼小型无人机三维路径跟踪制导
AI.tldr: 针对固定翼小型无人机，研究人员开发了两种基于非线性MPC的3D路径跟踪制导器，并通过实际飞行测试证明了它们在高速高曲率路径上优于传统方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 为固定翼小型无人机（UAS）设计和实现有效的3D路径跟踪制导算法，以应对复杂的3D弧长参数化曲线跟踪任务。
AI.method: 提出了两种基于非线性模型预测控制（MPC）的3D路径跟踪制导算法。第一种对MPC视界上的静态参考路径速率进行调度，以激励恒定的惯性速度。第二种受模型预测轮廓控制的启发，动态优化控制器视界上的参考路径速率，以在路径进展和偏离路径距离之间进行权衡。控制器的设计基于RAAVEN小型无人机的控制增强建模和系统辨识。
AI.result: 两种MPC制导算法在实际飞行测试中表现出优越的性能，证明了非线性MPC在3D路径跟踪制导中的实际可行性，尤其是在高速（高达36米/秒）和高曲率路径上。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的非线性MPC制导算法在高达36米/秒的地面速度下，在多条高曲率测试路径上展示了实际可行性和优于基线前视制导法的性能。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了两种基于非线性模型预测控制（MPC）的新颖三维路径跟踪制导算法的设计、实现和飞行测试结果，专门应用于固定翼小型无人机系统。为实现MPC，本文介绍了RAAVEN小型无人机的控制增强建模和系统辨识。随后展示了两种MPC的方案。第一种在MPC视界上调度静态参考路径速率，激励恒定的惯性速度。第二种受模型预测轮廓控制的启发，在系统运行时动态优化控制器视界上的参考路径速率。这允许在路径进展和偏离路径距离之间进行加权权衡，这是路径跟踪制导中的两个相互竞争的目标。两种控制器都被设计为在一般平滑的、由弧长参数化的三维曲线上运行。MPC制导算法在几条高曲率测试路径上进行了飞行，并与基线前视制导律进行了比较。结果展示了非线性MPC在高达每秒36米地面速度下进行三维路径跟踪制导的实际可行性和卓越性能。
AI.summary: 本文为固定翼小型无人机设计并飞行测试了两种新颖的基于非线性模型预测控制（MPC）的3D路径跟踪制导算法。这些算法适用于通用的3D平滑曲线，其中一种采用静态路径速率调度，另一种动态优化路径速率以平衡路径进展和偏航误差。飞行测试结果表明，与基线方法相比，非线性MPC在实际应用中具有优越的性能和可行性。
AI.keywords: 非线性MPC, 3D路径跟踪, 无人机, 轨迹跟踪, 模型预测控制
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地提出了两种基于非线性模型预测控制（MPC）的3D路径跟踪制导算法，并针对固定翼小型无人机进行了实际飞行测试。其重要性在于展示了MPC在复杂3D路径跟踪任务中的优越性能和实际可行性。一个潜在的局限是，虽然提到了系统辨识，但未详细说明辨识的鲁棒性或对模型不确定性的处理。

title: World model inspired sarcasm reasoning with large language model agents
summary: Sarcasm understanding is a challenging problem in natural language processing, as it requires capturing the discrepancy between the surface meaning of an utterance and the speaker's intentions as well as the surrounding social context. Although recent advances in deep learning and Large Language Models (LLMs) have substantially improved performance, most existing approaches still rely on black-box predictions of a single model, making it difficult to structurally explain the cognitive factors underlying sarcasm. Moreover, while sarcasm often emerges as a mismatch between semantic evaluation and normative expectations or intentions, frameworks that explicitly decompose and model these components remain limited. In this work, we reformulate sarcasm understanding as a world model inspired reasoning process and propose World Model inspired SArcasm Reasoning (WM-SAR), which decomposes literal meaning, context, normative expectation, and intention into specialized LLM-based agents. The discrepancy between literal evaluation and normative expectation is explicitly quantified as a deterministic inconsistency score, and together with an intention score, these signals are integrated by a lightweight Logistic Regression model to infer the final sarcasm probability. This design leverages the reasoning capability of LLMs while maintaining an interpretable numerical decision structure. Experiments on representative sarcasm detection benchmarks show that WM-SAR consistently outperforms existing deep learning and LLM-based methods. Ablation studies and case analyses further demonstrate that integrating semantic inconsistency and intention reasoning is essential for effective sarcasm detection, achieving both strong performance and high interpretability.

AI.title_translation: 受世界模型启发的带有大型语言模型代理的讽刺推理
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为WM-SAR的新方法，通过分解和建模讽刺理解中的不同因素（字面意义、语境、规范期望和意图），并利用LLM代理进行推理，从而提高了讽刺检测的性能和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的讽刺理解方法大多依赖于黑盒模型，难以解释其认知因素，并且缺乏显式分解和建模字面意义与规范期望或意图之间不匹配的框架。
AI.method: 将讽刺理解重新构建为受世界模型启发的推理过程，提出WM-SAR方法，将字面意义、语境、规范期望和意图分解为专门的LLM代理。通过量化字面评估与规范期望之间的差异（不一致分数）以及意图分数，并结合一个轻量级的逻辑回归模型来推断最终的讽刺概率。
AI.result: WM-SAR在代表性的讽刺检测基准测试中持续优于现有的深度学习和基于LLM的方法。消融研究和案例分析表明，整合语义不一致和意图推理对于有效的讽刺检测至关重要，同时实现了强大的性能和高可解释性。
AI.conclusion: WM-SAR通过将讽刺理解建模为一种受世界模型启发的、由多个LLM代理组成的推理过程，成功地提高了讽刺检测的性能和可解释性，并证明了分解语义不一致和意图推理的重要性。
AI.translation: 讽刺理解是自然语言处理中的一个挑战性问题，因为它需要捕捉话语的表面意义与说话者的意图以及周围的社会背景之间的差异。尽管深度学习和大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展在性能上有了显著提高，但大多数现有方法仍然依赖于单一模型的黑盒预测，使得讽刺背后的认知因素难以进行结构化解释。此外，虽然讽刺通常表现为语义评估与规范期望或意图之间的不匹配，但显式分解和建模这些组成部分的框架仍然有限。在本研究中，我们将讽刺理解重新表述为受世界模型启发的推理过程，并提出受世界模型启发的讽刺推理（WM-SAR），它将字面意义、语境、规范期望和意图分解为专门的基于LLM的代理。字面评估与规范期望之间的差异被显式量化为确定性不一致分数，并且与意图分数一起，这些信号被一个轻量级的逻辑回归模型整合，以推断最终的讽刺概率。这种设计利用了LLM的推理能力，同时保持了可解释的数值决策结构。在代表性的讽刺检测基准测试上的实验表明，WM-SAR持续优于现有的深度学习和基于LLM的方法。消融研究和案例分析进一步证明，整合语义不一致和意图推理对于有效的讽刺检测至关重要，实现了强大的性能和高可解释性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为WM-SAR的新框架，用于讽刺理解。该框架受世界模型启发，将讽刺理解分解为字面意义、语境、规范期望和意图四个关键组成部分，并利用专门的大型语言模型（LLM）代理来分别处理这些部分。通过量化字面评估与规范期望之间的不一致性以及意图，并结合逻辑回归模型进行最终预测，WM-SAR在提高讽刺检测性能的同时，也实现了更好的可解释性，克服了传统黑盒模型的局限性。
AI.keywords: 讽刺检测, 大型语言模型, 世界模型, 解释性AI, 认知推理
AI.comments: 该研究在讽刺理解领域取得了显著进展，通过引入受世界模型启发的LLM代理框架，不仅提高了模型的性能，而且增强了模型的可解释性，这对于理解和调试复杂的NLP任务非常有价值。未来可以进一步探索不同LLM代理之间的交互机制以及如何将其应用于更广泛的推理任务。

title: SenseNova-MARS: Empowering Multimodal Agentic Reasoning and Search via Reinforcement Learning
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can solve complex tasks through agentic reasoning, their capabilities remain largely constrained to text-oriented chain-of-thought or isolated tool invocation. They fail to exhibit the human-like proficiency required to seamlessly interleave dynamic tool manipulation with continuous reasoning, particularly in knowledge-intensive and visually complex scenarios that demand coordinated external tools such as search and image cropping. In this work, we introduce SenseNova-MARS, a novel Multimodal Agentic Reasoning and Search framework that empowers VLMs with interleaved visual reasoning and tool-use capabilities via reinforcement learning (RL). Specifically, SenseNova-MARS dynamically integrates the image search, text search, and image crop tools to tackle fine-grained and knowledge-intensive visual understanding challenges. In the RL stage, we propose the Batch-Normalized Group Sequence Policy Optimization (BN-GSPO) algorithm to improve the training stability and advance the model's ability to invoke tools and reason effectively. To comprehensively evaluate the agentic VLMs on complex visual tasks, we introduce the HR-MMSearch benchmark, the first search-oriented benchmark composed of high-resolution images with knowledge-intensive and search-driven questions. Experiments demonstrate that SenseNova-MARS achieves state-of-the-art performance on open-source search and fine-grained image understanding benchmarks. Specifically, on search-oriented benchmarks, SenseNova-MARS-8B scores 67.84 on MMSearch and 41.64 on HR-MMSearch, surpassing proprietary models such as Gemini-3-Flash and GPT-5. SenseNova-MARS represents a promising step toward agentic VLMs by providing effective and robust tool-use capabilities. To facilitate further research in this field, we will release all code, models, and datasets.

AI.title_translation: SenseNova-MARS：通过强化学习赋能多模态智能体推理与搜索
AI.tldr: SenseNova-MARS是一个基于强化学习的多模态智能体框架，它通过集成搜索和图像裁剪等工具，显著增强了VLMs在复杂视觉任务中的推理和工具使用能力，并在新基准HR-MMSearch上超越了现有领先模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在解决复杂任务时，其能力主要局限于面向文本的思维链或孤立的工具调用，未能展现出像人类一样流畅地交织动态工具操作与连续推理的能力，尤其是在需要协调外部工具（如搜索和图像裁剪）的知识密集和视觉复杂的场景中。
AI.method: SenseNova-MARS框架通过强化学习（RL）赋予VLMs交错的视觉推理和工具使用能力，动态集成图像搜索、文本搜索和图像裁剪工具来解决细粒度和知识密集型的视觉理解挑战。训练阶段采用了新提出的批量归一化组序列策略优化（BN-GSPO）算法。同时，引入了HR-MMSearch基准测试来评估智能体VLMs。
AI.result: SenseNova-MARS在开源搜索和细粒度图像理解基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。在面向搜索的基准测试中，SenseNova-MARS-8B在MMSearch上得分67.84，在HR-MMSearch上得分41.64，超越了Gemini-3-Flash和GPT-5等专有模型。
AI.conclusion: SenseNova-MARS通过提供有效且强大的工具使用能力，代表了迈向智能体视觉语言模型（VLMs）的一个有希望的步骤。研究团队将发布所有代码、模型和数据集以促进未来研究。
AI.translation: 虽然视觉语言模型（VLMs）可以通过智能体推理解决复杂任务，但它们的能力在很大程度上仍然局限于面向文本的思维链或孤立的工具调用。它们未能展现出人类所需的熟练程度，即无缝地交织动态工具操作与连续推理，特别是在需要协调外部工具（如搜索和图像裁剪）的知识密集和视觉复杂的场景中。在这项工作中，我们提出了SenseNova-MARS，一个新颖的多模态智能体推理与搜索框架，它通过强化学习（RL）赋予VLMs交错的视觉推理和工具使用能力。具体来说，SenseNova-MARS动态集成了图像搜索、文本搜索和图像裁剪工具，以应对细粒度和知识密集型的视觉理解挑战。在RL阶段，我们提出了批量归一化组序列策略优化（BN-GSPO）算法，以提高训练稳定性和推进模型有效调用工具和推理的能力。为了全面评估智能体VLMs在复杂视觉任务上的表现，我们引入了HR-MMSearch基准测试，这是第一个由高分辨率图像组成的、面向搜索的基准，包含知识密集和搜索驱动的问题。实验证明，SenseNova-MARS在开源搜索和细粒度图像理解基准测试上取得了最先进的性能。具体而言，在面向搜索的基准测试中，SenseNova-MARS-8B在MMSearch上得分67.84，在HR-MMSearch上得分41.64，超越了Gemini-3-Flash和GPT-5等专有模型。SenseNova-MARS通过提供有效且强大的工具使用能力，代表了迈向智能体VLMs的一个有希望的步骤。为了促进该领域的进一步研究，我们将发布所有代码、模型和数据集。
AI.summary: SenseNova-MARS是一个新颖的多模态智能体推理与搜索框架，它利用强化学习（RL）使视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够无缝集成动态工具操作（如图像搜索、文本搜索和图像裁剪）与连续推理，以解决知识密集和视觉复杂的任务。该框架引入了BN-GSPO算法以稳定训练，并推出了HR-MMSearch基准测试。实验证明，SenseNova-MARS在搜索导向任务上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 多模态智能体, 视觉语言模型, 强化学习, 工具使用, 知识密集型任务
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个能将动态工具操作与连续推理无缝交织的多模态智能体框架SenseNova-MARS，并引入了BN-GSPO算法来稳定训练。其重要性在于解决了现有VLM在处理知识密集和视觉复杂的任务时，工具使用和推理能力受限的问题，并通过HR-MMSearch基准测试证明了其在搜索导向任务上的优越性。局限性在于，虽然提升了性能，但作为新的框架，其泛化能力和对更复杂场景的支持仍有待进一步验证。

title: Spatial-aware Vision Language Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show significant promise for end-to-end autonomous driving by leveraging the common sense embedded in language models, their reliance on 2D image cues for complex scene understanding and decision-making presents a critical bottleneck for safety and reliability. Current image-based methods struggle with accurate metric spatial reasoning and geometric inference, leading to unreliable driving policies. To bridge this gap, we propose LVLDrive (LiDAR-Vision-Language), a novel framework specifically designed to upgrade existing VLMs with robust 3D metric spatial understanding for autonomous driving by incoperating LiDAR point cloud as an extra input modality. A key challenge lies in mitigating the catastrophic disturbance introduced by disparate 3D data to the pre-trained VLMs. To this end, we introduce a Gradual Fusion Q-Former that incrementally injects LiDAR features, ensuring the stability and preservation of the VLM's existing knowledge base. Furthermore, we develop a spatial-aware question-answering (SA-QA) dataset to explicitly teach the model advanced 3D perception and reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments on driving benchmarks demonstrate that LVLDrive achieves superior performance compared to vision-only counterparts across scene understanding, metric spatial perception, and reliable driving decision-making. Our work highlights the necessity of explicit 3D metric data for building trustworthy VLM-based autonomous systems.

AI.title_translation: 面向自动驾驶的空间感知视觉语言模型
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了LVLDrive框架，通过融合激光雷达点云数据来增强现有视觉语言模型（VLMs）在自动驾驶中的3D空间理解能力，解决了仅依赖2D图像导致的空间推理瓶颈，并取得了更好的驾驶决策性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于2D图像的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在自动驾驶中存在对复杂场景理解和决策制定的瓶颈，因为它们在精确的度量空间推理和几何推断方面存在困难，这影响了驾驶策略的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出LVLDrive框架，将激光雷达点云作为额外输入模态，以增强现有VLMs的3D度量空间理解能力。通过引入渐进式融合Q-Former来逐步注入激光雷达特征，以稳定预训练VLMs。开发了空间感知问答（SA-QA）数据集来训练模型进行3D感知和推理。
AI.result: LVLDrive在场景理解、度量空间感知和可靠的驾驶决策制定方面，相比仅使用视觉信息的模型取得了更优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式地引入3D度量数据对于构建值得信赖的、基于VLM的自动驾驶系统是必要的。
AI.translation: 尽管视觉语言模型（VLMs）通过利用语言模型中嵌入的常识，在端到端自动驾驶方面显示出巨大潜力，但它们依赖2D图像线索进行复杂的场景理解和决策制定，这给安全性和可靠性带来了关键瓶颈。目前的基于图像的方法在精确的度量空间推理和几何推断方面存在困难，导致驾驶策略不可靠。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了LVLDrive（LiDAR-Vision-Language），一个专门为通过整合激光雷达点云作为额外输入模态来增强现有VLMs的鲁棒3D度量空间理解能力而设计的创新框架。一个关键的挑战在于减轻由不同的3D数据对预训练VLMs造成的灾难性干扰。为此，我们引入了一个渐进式融合Q-Former，它逐步注入激光雷达特征，确保VLM现有知识库的稳定性和保留。此外，我们开发了一个空间感知问答（SA-QA）数据集，以明确地教授模型高级的3D感知和推理能力。在驾驶基准上的广泛实验表明，在场景理解、度量空间感知和可靠的驾驶决策制定方面，LVLDrive的性能优于仅视觉的方法。我们的工作强调了构建值得信赖的基于VLM的自动驾驶系统需要显式的3D度量数据。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为LVLDrive的新型框架，通过整合激光雷达点云数据来增强自动驾驶中视觉语言模型（VLMs）的3D空间理解能力。该框架解决了仅依赖2D图像在度量空间推理和几何推断方面的局限性，通过渐进式融合Q-Former稳定地引入3D数据，并利用专门的空间感知问答（SA-QA）数据集进行训练。实验结果表明，LVLDrive在自动驾驶任务中，包括场景理解、空间感知和决策制定方面，性能优于仅基于视觉的模型，强调了3D数据对于构建可靠自动驾驶系统的必要性。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 视觉语言模型, 3D空间理解, 激光雷达, 渐进式融合
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了自动驾驶领域中一个关键的挑战，即如何让视觉语言模型（VLMs）更好地理解和利用3D空间信息。通过融合激光雷达数据并提出渐进式融合机制，LVLDrive有效地克服了传统2D图像方法的局限性。SA-QA数据集的创建也为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。然而，该方法在处理大规模、多样化数据集以及在真实世界复杂交通场景中的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。

title: A density-based framework for community detection in attributed networks
summary: Community structure in social and collaborative networks often emerges from a complex interplay between structural mechanisms, such as degree heterogeneity and leader-driven attraction, and homophily on node attributes. Existing community detection methods typically focus on these dimensions in isolation, limiting their ability to recover interpretable communities in presence of such mechanisms. In this paper, we propose AttDeCoDe, an attribute-driven extension of a density-based community detection framework, developed to analyse networks where node characteristics play a central role in group formation. Instead of defining density purely from network topology, AttDeCoDe estimates node-wise density in the attribute space, allowing communities to form around attribute-based community representatives while preserving structural connectivity constraints. This approach naturally captures homophily-driven aggregation while remaining sensitive to leader influence. We evaluate the proposed method through a simulation study based on a novel generative model that extends the degree-corrected stochastic block model by incorporating attribute-driven leader attraction, reflecting key features of collaborative research networks. We perform an empirical application to research collaboration data from the Horizon programmes, where organisations are characterised by project-level thematic descriptors. Both results show that AttDeCoDe offers a flexible and interpretable framework for community detection in attributed networks achieving competitive performance relative to topology-based and attribute-assisted benchmarks.

title: The Mechanics of CNN Filtering with Rectification
summary: This paper proposes elementary information mechanics as a new model for understanding the mechanical properties of convolutional filtering with rectification, inspired by physical theories of special relativity and quantum mechanics. We consider kernels decomposed into orthogonal even and odd components. Even components cause image content to diffuse isotropically while preserving the center of mass, analogously to rest or potential energy with zero net momentum. Odd kernels cause directional displacement of the center of mass, analogously to kinetic energy with non-zero momentum. The speed of information displacement is linearly related to the ratio of odd vs total kernel energy. Even-Odd properties are analyzed in the spectral domain via the discrete cosine transform (DCT), where the structure of small convolutional filters (e.g. $3 \times 3$ pixels) is dominated by low-frequency bases, specifically the DC $Σ$ and gradient components $\nabla$, which define the fundamental modes of information propagation. To our knowledge, this is the first work demonstrating the link between information processing in generic CNNs and the energy-momentum relation, a cornerstone of modern relativistic physics.

title: Proof-Carrying PWL Verification for ReLU Networks: Convex-Hull Semantics, Exact \SMT/\MILP Encodings, and Symbolic Certificate Checking
summary: ReLU networks are piecewise-linear (PWL), enabling exact symbolic verification via \SMT(\LRA) or \MILP. However, safety claims in certification pipelines require not only correctness but also \emph{checkable evidence}. We develop a proof-carrying verification core for PWL neural constraints: (i) we formalize ReLU networks as unions of polyhedra indexed by activation patterns; (ii) we present exact \SMT/\MILP encodings and the canonical convex-hull relaxation for each bounded ReLU; and (iii) we introduce a certificate calculus in which bound tightening, stabilization, strengthening, and pruning steps emit explicit algebraic witnesses (LP dual multipliers and Farkas infeasibility certificates). Crucially, these witnesses are \emph{symbolic objects} that admit independent verification in exact arithmetic over $\Q$. We provide a symbolic certificate checker, normalization rules that preserve validity, and a compositional view of region-wise certificates as a global proof artifact for universal safety.

title: DermaVQA-DAS: Dermatology Assessment Schema (DAS) & Datasets for Closed-Ended Question Answering & Segmentation in Patient-Generated Dermatology Images
summary: Recent advances in dermatological image analysis have been driven by large-scale annotated datasets; however, most existing benchmarks focus on dermatoscopic images and lack patient-authored queries and clinical context, limiting their applicability to patient-centered care. To address this gap, we introduce DermaVQA-DAS, an extension of the DermaVQA dataset that supports two complementary tasks: closed-ended question answering (QA) and dermatological lesion segmentation. Central to this work is the Dermatology Assessment Schema (DAS), a novel expert-developed framework that systematically captures clinically meaningful dermatological features in a structured and standardized form. DAS comprises 36 high-level and 27 fine-grained assessment questions, with multiple-choice options in English and Chinese. Leveraging DAS, we provide expert-annotated datasets for both closed QA and segmentation and benchmark state-of-the-art multimodal models. For segmentation, we evaluate multiple prompting strategies and show that prompt design impacts performance: the default prompt achieves the best results under Mean-of-Max and Mean-of-Mean evaluation aggregation schemes, while an augmented prompt incorporating both patient query title and content yields the highest performance under majority-vote-based microscore evaluation, achieving a Jaccard index of 0.395 and a Dice score of 0.566 with BiomedParse. For closed-ended QA, overall performance is strong across models, with average accuracies ranging from 0.729 to 0.798; o3 achieves the best overall accuracy (0.798), closely followed by GPT-4.1 (0.796), while Gemini-1.5-Pro shows competitive performance within the Gemini family (0.783). We publicly release DermaVQA-DAS, the DAS schema, and evaluation protocols to support and accelerate future research in patient-centered dermatological vision-language modeling (https://osf.io/72rp3).

title: FedSecureFormer: A Fast, Federated and Secure Transformer Framework for Lightweight Intrusion Detection in Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
summary: This works presents an encoder-only transformer built with minimum layers for intrusion detection in the domain of Connected and Autonomous Vehicles using Federated Learning.

title: Effects of Algorithmic Visibility on Conspiracy Communities: Reddit after Epstein's 'Suicide'
summary:
This paper examines how algorithmic visibility shapes a large conspiracy community on Reddit after Jeffrey Epstein's death.
  We ask whether homepage exposure changes who join r/conspiracy, how long they stay, and how they adapt linguistically, compared with users who arrive through organic discovery.
  Using a computational framework that combines toxicity scores, survival analysis, and lexical and semantic measures, the study shows that homepage visibility acts as a selection mechanism rather than a simple amplifier.
  Users who discover the community organically integrate more quickly into its linguistic and thematic norms and show more stable engagement over time.
  By contrast, users who arrive through visibility on the homepage remain semantically distant from core discourse and participate more briefly.
  Overall, algorithmic visibility reshapes audience size, community composition, and linguistic cohesion:
  newcomers who do not join organically have different incentives, integrate weakly, and leave quickly, which limits organic growth.
  In this high-risk setting, the observed behavioral and linguistic trajectories over five months do not match standard narratives in which incidental exposure to conspiracy content produces durable radicalization.
  These findings can inform the design of web platforms and recommendation systems that seek to curb harmful conspiracy exposure while supporting more responsible, transparent, and socially beneficial uses of algorithmic recommendations.

title: Faster Algorithms for Global Minimum Vertex-Cut in Directed Graphs
comments: 122 pages, 0 figures, to be published in SODA2026
summary: We study the directed global minimum vertex-cut problem: given a directed vertex-weighted graph $G$, compute a vertex-cut $(L,S,R)$ in $G$ of minimum value, which is defined to be the total weight of all vertices in $S$. The problem, together with its edge-based variant, is one of the most basic in graph theory and algorithms, and has been studied extensively. The fastest currently known algorithm for directed global minimum vertex-cut (Henzinger, Rao and Gabow, FOCS 1996 and J. Algorithms 2000) has running time $\tilde{O}(mn)$, where $m$ and $n$ denote the number of edges and vertices in the input graph, respectively. A long line of work over the past decades led to faster algorithms for other main versions of the problem, including the undirected edge-based setting (Karger, STOC 1996 and J. ACM 2000), directed edge-based setting (Cen et al., FOCS 2021), and undirected vertex-based setting (Chuzhoy and Trabelsi, STOC 2025). However, for the vertex-based version in directed graphs, the 29 year-old $\tilde{O}(mn)$-time algorithm of Henzinger, Rao and Gabow remains the state of the art to this day, in all edge-density regimes. In this paper we break the $Θ(mn)$ running time barrier for the first time, by providing a randomized algorithm for directed global minimum vertex-cut, with running time $O\left(mn^{0.976}\cdot\operatorname{polylog} W\right)$ where $W$ is the ratio of largest to smallest vertex weight. Additionally, we provide a randomized $O\left(\min\left\{m^{1+o(1)}\cdot k,n^{2+o(1)}\right\}\right)$-time algorithm for the unweighted version of directed global minimum vertex-cut, where $k$ is the value of the optimal solution. The best previous algorithm for the problem achieved running time $\tilde O\left(\min\left\{k^2 \cdot m, mn^{11/12+o(1)}, n^{2+o(1)}\right\}\right)$ (Forster et al., SODA 2020, Li et al., STOC 2021).

title: Learning Context: A Unified Framework and Roadmap for Context-Aware AI in Education
summary: We introduce a unified Learning Context (LC) framework designed to transition AI-based education from context-blind mimicry to a principled, holistic understanding of the learner. This white paper provides a multidisciplinary roadmap for making teaching and learning systems context-aware by encoding cognitive, affective, and sociocultural factors over the short, medium, and long term. To realize this vision, we outline concrete steps to operationalize LC theory into an interoperable computational data structure. By leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP), we will enable a wide range of AI tools to "warm-start" with durable context and achieve continual, long-term personalization. Finally, we detail our particular LC implementation strategy through the OpenStax digital learning platform ecosystem and SafeInsights R&D infrastructure. Using OpenStax's national reach, we are embedding the LC into authentic educational settings to support millions of learners. All research and pedagogical interventions are conducted within SafeInsights' privacy-preserving data enclaves, ensuring a privacy-first implementation that maintains high ethical standards while reducing equity gaps nationwide.

title: On the Factual Consistency of Text-based Explainable Recommendation Models
summary: Text-based explainable recommendation aims to generate natural-language explanations that justify item recommendations, to improve user trust and system transparency. Although recent advances leverage LLMs to produce fluent outputs, a critical question remains underexplored: are these explanations factually consistent with the available evidence? We introduce a comprehensive framework for evaluating the factual consistency of text-based explainable recommenders. We design a prompting-based pipeline that uses LLMs to extract atomic explanatory statements from reviews, thereby constructing a ground truth that isolates and focuses on their factual content. Applying this pipeline to five categories from the Amazon Reviews dataset, we create augmented benchmarks for fine-grained evaluation of explanation quality. We further propose statement-level alignment metrics that combine LLM- and NLI-based approaches to assess both factual consistency and relevance of generated explanations. Across extensive experiments on six state-of-the-art explainable recommendation models, we uncover a critical gap: while models achieve high semantic similarity scores (BERTScore F1: 0.81-0.90), all our factuality metrics reveal alarmingly low performance (LLM-based statement-level precision: 4.38%-32.88%). These findings underscore the need for factuality-aware evaluation in explainable recommendation and provide a foundation for developing more trustworthy explanation systems.

title: Skim-Aware Contrastive Learning for Efficient Document Representation
summary: Although transformer-based models have shown strong performance in word- and sentence-level tasks, effectively representing long documents, especially in fields like law and medicine, remains difficult. Sparse attention mechanisms can handle longer inputs, but are resource-intensive and often fail to capture full-document context. Hierarchical transformer models offer better efficiency but do not clearly explain how they relate different sections of a document. In contrast, humans often skim texts, focusing on important sections to understand the overall message. Drawing from this human strategy, we introduce a new self-supervised contrastive learning framework that enhances long document representation. Our method randomly masks a section of the document and uses a natural language inference (NLI)-based contrastive objective to align it with relevant parts while distancing it from unrelated ones. This mimics how humans synthesize information, resulting in representations that are both richer and more computationally efficient. Experiments on legal and biomedical texts confirm significant gains in both accuracy and efficiency.

title: New Insights into Cascaded Geometric Flight Control: From Performance Guarantees to Practical Pitfalls
summary: We present a new stability proof for cascaded geometric control used by aerial vehicles tracking time-varying position trajectories. Our approach uses sliding variables and a recently proposed quaternion-based sliding controller to demonstrate that exponentially convergent position trajectory tracking is theoretically possible. Notably, our analysis reveals new aspects of the control strategy, including how tracking error in the attitude loop influences the position loop, how model uncertainties affect the closed-loop system, and the practical pitfalls of the control architecture.

title: Tubular Riemannian Laplace Approximations for Bayesian Neural Networks
summary: Laplace approximations are among the simplest and most practical methods for approximate Bayesian inference in neural networks, yet their Euclidean formulation struggles with the highly anisotropic, curved loss surfaces and large symmetry groups that characterize modern deep models. Recent work has proposed Riemannian and geometric Gaussian approximations to adapt to this structure. Building on these ideas, we introduce the Tubular Riemannian Laplace (TRL) approximation. TRL explicitly models the posterior as a probabilistic tube that follows a low-loss valley induced by functional symmetries, using a Fisher/Gauss-Newton metric to separate prior-dominated tangential uncertainty from data-dominated transverse uncertainty. We interpret TRL as a scalable reparametrised Gaussian approximation that utilizes implicit curvature estimates to operate in high-dimensional parameter spaces. Our empirical evaluation on ResNet-18 (CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100) demonstrates that TRL achieves excellent calibration, matching or exceeding the reliability of Deep Ensembles (in terms of ECE) while requiring only a fraction (1/5) of the training cost. TRL effectively bridges the gap between single-model efficiency and ensemble-grade reliability.

title: Geometric Multi-Session Map Merging with Learned Local Descriptors
summary: Multi-session map merging is crucial for extended autonomous operations in large-scale environments. In this paper, we present GMLD, a learning-based local descriptor framework for large-scale multi-session point cloud map merging that systematically aligns maps collected across different sessions with overlapping regions. The proposed framework employs a keypoint-aware encoder and a plane-based geometric transformer to extract discriminative features for loop closure detection and relative pose estimation. To further improve global consistency, we include inter-session scan matching cost factors in the factor-graph optimization stage. We evaluate our framework on the public datasets, as well as self-collected data from diverse environments. The results show accurate and robust map merging with low error, and the learned features deliver strong performance in both loop closure detection and relative pose estimation.

title: Forging Spatial Intelligence: A Roadmap of Multi-Modal Data Pre-Training for Autonomous Systems
comments: Preprint; 38 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables; GitHub at https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-spatial-intelligence
summary: The rapid advancement of autonomous systems, including self-driving vehicles and drones, has intensified the need to forge true Spatial Intelligence from multi-modal onboard sensor data. While foundation models excel in single-modal contexts, integrating their capabilities across diverse sensors like cameras and LiDAR to create a unified understanding remains a formidable challenge. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for multi-modal pre-training, identifying the core set of techniques driving progress toward this goal. We dissect the interplay between foundational sensor characteristics and learning strategies, evaluating the role of platform-specific datasets in enabling these advancements. Our central contribution is the formulation of a unified taxonomy for pre-training paradigms: ranging from single-modality baselines to sophisticated unified frameworks that learn holistic representations for advanced tasks like 3D object detection and semantic occupancy prediction. Furthermore, we investigate the integration of textual inputs and occupancy representations to facilitate open-world perception and planning. Finally, we identify critical bottlenecks, such as computational efficiency and model scalability, and propose a roadmap toward general-purpose multi-modal foundation models capable of achieving robust Spatial Intelligence for real-world deployment.
